hint: Imam al-Busiri — 10 chapitres avec audio synchronisé

lines.ar: الفصل ١
أَمِنْ تَذَكُّرِ جِيرَانٍ بِذِي سَلَمِ ٭ مَزَجْتَ دَمْعًا جَرَى مِنْ مُقْلَةٍ بِدَمِ
lines.translit: Amin tadhakkuri jīrānin bi dhī salami ٭ Mazajta damʿan jarā min muqlatin bidami

tr.en: Is it from remembering neighbours at Dhū Salam ٭ That you shed tears admixed with blood from your eyes?
tr.enSingable: Is it from thinking of neighbors past in Dhu Selemi ٭ That you have mixed blood in tears that flow from eyes steadily?
tr.id: Apakah karena mengingat tetangga tercinta yang berada di Dzu Salam ٭ hingga air matamu mengalir deras bercampur darah?

lines.ar: أَمْ هَبَّتِ الرِّيحُ مِنْ تِلْقَاءِ كَاظِمَةٍ ٭ وَأَوْمَضَ البَرْقُ فِي الظَّلْمَاءِ مِنْ إِضَمِ
lines.translit: Am habbatir rīhu min tilqāʾi kādhimatin ٭ Wa awmaḍal barqu fīẓ ẓulmāʾi min iḍami

tr.en: Or because wind has blown from the direction of Kāẓima ٭ And lightning has flashed in the dark of Iḍam?
tr.enSingable: Or blowing of wind from the direction of Kazimah, ٭ And lightning flashing from Idum in the dark that you see?
tr.id: Ataukah karena hembusan angin dari arah Kazhimah, ٭ atau kilauan cahaya kilat pada kegelapan dari arah Idham?

lines.ar: فَمَا لِعَيْنَيْكَ إِنْ قُلْتَ اكْفُفَا هَمَتَا ٭ وَمَا لِقَلْبِكَ إِنْ قُلْتَ اسْتَفِقْ يَهِمِ
lines.translit: Famā li ʿaynayka in qultakfufā hamatā ٭ Wa mā li qalbika in qultastafiq yahimi

tr.en: So what ails your eyes that when you tell them ‘stop’, they continue to weep still more? ٭ And what ails your heart that when you bid it awake, it wanders further in distraction?
tr.enSingable: So what is wrong with your eyes: when you say "Stop!" they just weep? ٭ And with your heart: when you say, "Be sane!" it acts crazily?
tr.id: Mengapa dengan kedua matamu? Jika engkau menahan air mata, keduanya tetap basah. ٭ Ada apa dengan hatimu? Jika kau sadarkan, ia tetap gelisah.

lines.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ الصَّبُّ أَنَّ الحُبَّ مُنْكَتِمٌ ٭ مَا بَيْنَ مُنْسَجِمٍ مِنْهُ وَمُضْطَرِمِ
lines.translit: Ayaḥsabuṣ ṣabbu annal ḥubba munkatimun ٭ Mā bayna munsajimin minhu wa muḍṭarimi

tr.en: Does the lovelorn man think that love can be hidden ٭ Behind a torrent from his [eyes], or a heart’s raging fire?
tr.enSingable: Does one so lovestruck imagine love is concealable, ٭ Between a downpour from it and being so fiery?
tr.id: Apakah pemabuk cinta mengira rasa cintanya dapat tersembunyi ٭ di balik deraian air mata dan gelora cinta di dada?

lines.ar: لَوْلاَ الهَوَى لَمْ تَرِقْ دَمْعًا عَلَى طَلَلٍ ٭ وَلاَ أَرِقْتَ لِذِكْرِ البَانِ وَالْعَلَمِ
lines.translit: Lawlal hawā lam turiq damʿan ʿalā ṭalalin ٭ Wa lā ariqta li dhikril bāni wal ʿalami

tr.en: But for passion, you would not shed tears at an abandoned camp, ٭ Or lie awake at night recalling the fragrant willow or the mountain;
tr.enSingable: If not for passion, you would have never burst into tears ٭ At the remains, nor lost sleep over the mount or the tree.
tr.id: Andai bukan karena cinta, air matamu takkan mengalir saat melihat sisa reruntuhan rumah sang kekasih ٭ dan tidak pula engkau terjaga untuk mengenang pohon Ban dan bukit yang mengingatkanmu pada sang kekasih.

lines.ar: فَكَيْفَ تُنْكِرُ حُبًّا بَعْدَمَا شَهِدَتْ ٭ بِهِ عَلَيْكَ عُدُولُ الدَّمْعِ وَالسَّقَمِ
lines.translit: Fakayfa tunkiru ḥubban baʿda mā shahidat ٭ Bihi ʿalayka ʿudūlud damʿi was saqami

tr.en: So how can you deny this love when tears and sickness, ٭ truthful witnesses, have testified to it against you?
tr.enSingable: So how do you still deny a love to which testified ٭ Against you true witnesses of tears and infirmity;
tr.id: Bagaimana engkau masih mengingkari rasa cintamu, padahal ٭ air mata dan derita telah jujur bersaksi;

lines.ar: وَأَثْبَتَ الوَجْدُ خَطَّيْ عَبْرَةٍ وَضَنىً ٭ مِثْلَ البَهَارِ عَلَى خَدَّيْكَ وَالعَنَمِ
lines.translit: Wa athbatal wajdu khaṭṭay ʿabratin wa ḍanā ٭ Mithlal bahāri ʿalā khaddayka wal ʿanami

tr.en: Lovesickness has etched two lines, of tears and gauntness, ٭ Upon your cheeks, like yellow spice and red ʿanam
tr.enSingable: When grief has fixed on your cheeks canals of tears and malaise ٭ Like branches of dogwood, red, and daffodils, yellowy?
tr.id: Dan derita cintamu telah meninggalkan dua garis bekas linangan air mata dan membuatmu kurus lemah, ٭ laksana bunga kuning di kedua pipi dan mawar merah?

lines.ar: نَعَمْ سَرَى طَيْفُ مَنْ أَهْوَى فَأَرَّقَنِي ٭ وَالحُبُّ يَعْتَرِضُ اللَّذَّاتِ بِالأَلَمِ
lines.translit: Naʿam sarā ṭayfu man ahwā fa arraqanī ٭ Wal ḥubbu yaʿtariḍul ladhdhati bil alami

tr.en: Yes, my beloved’s apparition came to me and denied me sleep, ٭ For love always opposes pleasures with pain!
tr.enSingable: Yes, sights of my love have come at night and kept me awake; ٭ How love repels all delights and comforts with agony!
tr.id: Benar! Bayangan kekasihku selalu terlintas dalam benakku hingga membuatku terjaga. ٭ Begitulah cinta, dapat mendatangkan derita di balik kenikmatan.

lines.ar: يَا لاَئِمِي فِي الهَوَى العُذْرِيِّ مَعْذِرَةً ٭ مِنِّي إِلَيْكَ وَلَوْ أَنْصَفْتَ لَمْ تَلُمِ
lines.translit: Yā lāʾimī fīl hawal ʿudhriyyi maʿdhiratan ٭ Minnī ilayka wa law anṣafta lam talumi

tr.en: O you who blame me for this chaste love, pardon me! ٭ But had you judged fairly, you would not have blamed me.
tr.enSingable: You critic of love so passionate, an apology ٭ From me to you-but if you were true, you'd not censure me.
tr.id: Wahai, para pencelaku karena gelora cinta suci ini! Aku maklumi cacianmu. ٭ Seandainya engkau bersikap adil, niscaya kau takkan mencelaku.

lines.ar: عَدَتْكَ حَالِي لاَ سِرِّي بِمُسْتَتِرٍ ٭ عَنِ الْوُشَاةِ وَلاَ دَائِي بِمُنْحَسِمِ
lines.translit: ʿAdatka ḥāliya lā sirrī bi mustatirin ٭ ʿAnil wushāti wa lā dāʾī bimunḥasimi

tr.en: May you be spared my condition! My secret cannot be concealed ٭ From detractors, nor is there any cure for my ailment!
tr.enSingable: May you be spared what I bear-my secret isn't concealed ٭ From haters, nor is there any end to my malady.
tr.id: Kau telah mengetahui keadaanku. Kini rahasiaku tak dapat tersembunyi ٭ dari para pemfitnah, sedangkan penyakit yang menimpaku tak kunjung pulih.

lines.ar: مَحَّضْتَنِي النُصْحَ لَكِنْ لَسْتُ أَسْمَعُهُ ٭ إِنَّ المُحِبَّ عَنْ العُذَّالِ فِي صَمَمِ
lines.translit: Maḥḥaḍtanī nuṣḥa lākin lastu asmaʿuhu ٭ Innal muḥibba ʿanil ʿudhdhāli fī ṣamami

tr.en: You have given me sincere advice, but I cannot hear it; ٭ A lover’s ears are deaf to the reproaches of critics.
tr.enSingable: You've offered me true advice, but simply, I hear it not; ٭ The lover is deaf to all of those who speak critically.
tr.id: Engkau begitu tulus menasihatiku, tapi aku tak pernah mendengarkannya. ٭ Sungguh, pecinta selalu tuli untuk mendengar pencaci.

lines.ar: إِنِّي اتَّهَمْتُ نَصِيحَ الشَّيْبِ فِي عَذَليِ ٭ وَالشَّيْبُ أَبْعَدُ فِي نُصْحِ عَنِ التُّهَمِ
lines.translit: Innit tahamtu naṣīḥash shaybi fī ʿadhalī ٭ Wash shaybu abʿadu fī nuṣḥin ʿanit tuhami

tr.en: I hold suspect even the advice of my own grey hairs, ٭ Even though their advice is far from deception.
tr.enSingable: I've even doubted gray hair's advice when it censures me; ٭ Although gray hair with advice is less in dubiety.
tr.id: Sungguh, aku telah menuduh nasihat ubanku ikut mencela. ٭ Padahal, nasihat uban sangat tulus dan tak layak dicurigai.

lines.ar: الفصل ٢

tr.fr: 2. Sur la mise en garde contre les caprices de l'âme

lines.ar: فَإِنَّ أَمَّارَتيِ بِالسُّوءِ مَا اتَّعَظَتْ ٭ مِنْ جَهْلِهَا بِنَذِيرِ الشَّيْبِ وَالهَرَمِ
lines.translit: Fa inna ammāratī bis sūʾi mat taʿaẓat ٭ Min jahlihā bi nadhīrish shaybi wal harami

tr.en: Because of its ignorance, my ill-commanding ego has paid no heed ٭ To the warner of grey hair and approaching old age;
tr.enSingable: My evil ego, in its stupidity, paid no heed ٭ To all the warning of graying hair and seniority.
tr.id: Sungguh, hawa nafsuku tak dapat mendengar nasihat ٭ karena bodoh akan peringatan uban dan kerentaan.

lines.ar: وَلاَ أَعَدَّتْ مِنَ الفِعْلِ الجَمِيلِ قِرَى ٭ ضَيْفٍ أَلَمَّ بِرَأْسِي غَيْرَ مُحْتَشِمِ
lines.translit: Wa lā aʿaddat minal fiʿlil jamīli qirā ٭ Ḍayfin alamma bi raʾsī ghayra muḥtashimi

tr.en: Nor has it prepared good deeds in welcome ٭ For an unannounced guest who has settled on my head.
tr.enSingable: And hasn't set out a spread of pleasing actions to host ٭ A guest who showed at my head, bereft of timidity.
tr.id: Nafsuku tidak pula menyambut dengan jamuan amal baik ٭ untuk para tamu (uban) yang singgah di kepalaku tanpa rasa malu.

lines.ar: لَوْ كُنْتُ أَعْلَمُ أَنِّي مَا أُوَقِّرُهُ ٭ كَتَمْتُ سِرًّا بَدَاليِ مَنْهُ بِالكَتَمِ
lines.translit: Law kuntu aʿlamu annī mā uwaqqiruhu ٭ Katamtu sirran badālī minhu bil katami

tr.en: Had I realised, I would not have honoured it; ٭ I would have used [black] katam-dye to hide what it showed
tr.enSingable: And had I known that I'd fail to honor him, I'd have hid- ٭ Den using hair colorant his first appearance to me.
tr.id: Andai tahu aku tak dapat memuliakannya, ٭ niscaya kusembunyikan rahasia ketuaanku (uban) dengan semir.

lines.ar: مَنْ لِي بِرَدِّ جِمَاحٍ مِنْ غَوَايَتِهَا ٭ كَمَا يُرَدُّ جِمَاحُ الخَيْلِ بِاللُّجُمِ
lines.translit: Man lī biraddi jimāḥin min ghiwāyatihā ٭ Kamā yuraddu jimāḥul khayli bil lujumi

tr.en: Who will help me restrain my bolting ego from its wilfulness ٭ As a rebellious horse may be restrained with reins?
tr.enSingable: Who's there for me to control the fight of its wandering- ٭ Just as a bit bridles horses in their obstinacy?
tr.id: Siapakah yang dapat mengembalikan hawa nafsuku dari kesesatannya, ٭ sebagaimana liarnya kuda dapat dikendalikan dengan tali kekang?

lines.ar: فَلاَ تَرُمْ بِالمَعَاصِي كَسْرَ شَهْوَتِهَا ٭ إِنَّ الطَّعَامَ يُقَوِّي شَهْوَةَ النَّهِمِ
lines.translit: Falā tarum bil maʿāṣī kasra shahwatihā ٭ Innaṭ ṭaʿāma yuqawwī shahwatan nahimi

tr.en: Do not try to thwart unlawful desires by satisfying them, ٭ For food only increases a glutton’s desires.
tr.enSingable: So do not count on offenses to get rid of its lust; ٭ Food only intensifies the craving of gluttony.
tr.id: Janganlah berangan-angan bisa menghentikan hawa nafsumu dengan melakukan kemaksiatan. ٭ Sungguh, makanan dapat memperkuat nafsu pemakan yang rakus.

lines.ar: وَالنَّفْسُ كَالطِّفِلِ إِنْ تُهْمِلْهُ شَبَّ عَلَى ٭ حُبِّ الرَّضَاعِ وَإِنْ تَفْطِمْهُ يَنْفَطِمِ
lines.translit: Wan nafsu kaṭṭifli in tuhmilhu shabba ʿalā ٭ Ḥubbir raḍāʿi wa in tafṭimhu yanfaṭimi

tr.en: The ego is like a child: neglect it and it will grow up loving ٭ To suckle; but if you wean it, it will be weaned.
tr.enSingable: The ego is like a baby: leave it and it grows up ٭ In love with suckling; but wean it, and it's weaned finally.
tr.id: Hawa nafsu laksana bayi. Jika dibiarkan, ia akan tetap menyusu sampai dewasa. ٭ Namun bila engkau sapih, dia akan berhenti dari kebiasaan menyusu itu.

lines.ar: فَاصْرِفْ هَوَاهَا وَحَاذِرْ أَنْ تُوَلِّيَهُ ٭ إِنَّ الهَوَى مَا تَوَلَّى يُصْمِ أَوْ يَصِمِ
lines.translit: Faṣrif hawāhā wa ḥādhir an tuwalliyahu ٭ Innal hawā mā tawallā yuṣmi aw yaṣimi

tr.en: Divert its vain desires and beware of giving it power, ٭ For vain desires pollute or destroy whatever they control.
tr.enSingable: So fight its whim, and beware of giving power to it; ٭ When whim's empowered, it kills or damages markedly.
tr.id: Maka palingkan keinginan nafsu. Waspadalah, jangan sampai dia menguasaimu. ٭ Sungguh, apabila nafsu telah berkuasa, niscaya ia akan membinasakan atau minimal mencercamu.

lines.ar: وَرَاعِهَا وَهِيَ فِي الأَعْمَالِ سَائِمَةٌ ٭ وَإِنْ هِيَ اسْتَحْلَتِ المَرْعَى فَلاَ تُسِمِ
lines.translit: Wa rāʿihā wa hiya fīl aʿmāli sāʾimatun ٭ Wa in hiyastaḥlatil marʿā falā tusimi

tr.en: Guard it as it grazes in the field of actions; ٭ And should it find the grazing sweet, do not let it roam.
tr.enSingable: And shepherd it carefully as it is grazing in deeds; ٭ And if the pasture you find it fancies, don't let it be.
tr.id: Gembalakan nafsumu dengan baik tatkala ia sedang sibuk mengerjakan kebaikan. Nafsu laksana gembalaan. ٭ Jika ia telah merasa nyaman di tempat gembalaan, engkau tak akan dapat mengendalikannya.

lines.ar: كَمْ حَسَّنَتْ لَذَّةً لِلْمَرْءِ قَاتِلَةً ٭ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ يَدْرِ أَنَّ السُّمَّ فِي الدَّسَمِ
lines.translit: Kam ḥassanat ladhdhatan lil marʾi qātilatan ٭ Min ḥaythu lam yadri annas summa fid dasami

tr.en: How often it has found delight in something fatal, ٭ For [one] cannot tell that there is poison in the fat!
tr.enSingable: How many times it's convinced a man of killer delights- ٭ While blind to the poison in the gravy so savory!
tr.id: Betapa sering hawa nafsu menggoda manusia dengan kenikmatan yang mematikan. ٭ Tanpa disadar, ada racun tersembunyi di balik makanan yang lezat.

lines.ar: وَاخْشَ الدَّسَائِسَ مِنْ جُوعٍ وَمِنْ شِبَعٍ ٭ فَرُبَّ مَخْمَصَةٍ شَرُّ مِنَ التُّخَمِ
lines.translit: Wakhshad dasāʾisa min jūʿin wa min shibaʿin ٭ Farubba makhmaṣatin sharrun minat tukhami

tr.en: Beware of the snares of hunger and of satiety, ٭ being hungry at times can be worse than gorging oneself!
tr.enSingable: Beware the ambush of being hungry and being full; ٭ Starvation at times is even worse than satiety.
tr.id: Takutlah terhadap tipuan yang disembunyikan nafsu pada rasa lapar dan kenyang. ٭ Terkadang, kelaparan lebih berbahaya daripada kekenyangan.

lines.ar: وَاسْتَفْرِغِ الدَّمْعَ مِنْ عَيْنٍ قَدِ امْتَلَأَتْ ٭ مِنَ المَحَارِمِ وَالْزَمْ حِمْيَةَ النَّدَمِ
lines.translit: Wastafrighid damʿa min ʿaynin qadimtalaʾat ٭ Minal maḥārimi walzam ḥimyatan nadami

tr.en: Empty out the tears from an eye that has filled itself up ٭ with forbidden sights. Maintain a strict diet of remorse.
tr.enSingable: And void of tears eyes that have been stuffed with forbidden things. ٭ Keep in the shelter of pure repentance unceasingly.
tr.id: Tumpahkanlah air mata dari mata yang penuh dosa. ٭ Senantiasalah dalam penyesalan akan maksiat yang telah kau perbuat.

lines.ar: وَخَالِفِ النَّفْسَ وَالشَّيْطَانَ وَاعْصِهِمَا ٭ وَإِنْ هُمَا مَحَضَاكَ النُّصْحَ فَاتَّهِمِ
lines.translit: Wa khālifin nafsa wash shayṭāna waʿṣihimā ٭ Wa in humā maḥaḍākan nuṣḥa fat tahimi

tr.en: Oppose the self and Satan and disobey them; ٭ If they offer you advice, be suspicious of them.
tr.enSingable: And contradict both the Self and Devil, and disobey! ٭ And if they give true advice to you, still look skeptically.
tr.id: Lawan hawa nafsu dan setan. Durhakalah terhadap mereka. ٭ Curigai bila keduanya terlihat tulus menasihatimu.

lines.ar: وَلاَ تُطِعْ مِنْهُمَا خَصْمًا وَلاَ حَكَمًا ٭ فَأَنْتَ تَعْرِفُ كَيْدَ الخَصْمِ وَالحَكَمِ
lines.translit: Wa lā tuṭiʿ minhumā khaṣman walā ḥakaman ٭ Fa anta taʿrifu kaydal khaṣmi wal ḥakami

tr.en: Obey neither of them, whether they oppose or give judgment, ٭ For you know the wiles of opponent and judge.
tr.enSingable: And do not settle with either as your lawyer or foe; ٭ You're well aware of a lawyer's and a foe's treachery.
tr.id: Janganlah engkau turuti nafsu dan setan, baik sebagai musuh maupun sebagai hakim. ٭ Sungguh, engkau telah mengetahui bagaimana tipu daya seorang musuh dan seorang hakim.

lines.ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ مِنْ قَوْلٍ بِلاَ عَمَلٍ ٭ لَقَدْ نَسَبْتُ بِهِ نَسْلاً لِذِي عُقُمِ
lines.translit: AstaghfiruLlāha min qawlin bilā ʿamalin ٭ Laqad nasbtu bihi naslan lidhī ʿuqumi

tr.en: I seek Allah’s forgiveness for words bereft of deeds, ٭ As by them I attributed progeny to a sterile man.
tr.enSingable: I ask for pardon from God for empty word with no deed; ٭ I have ascribed by it to a sterile man progeny.
tr.id: Aku memohon ampunan Allah dari ucapan yang tidak kuamalkan. ٭ Sungguh, aku telah menyematkan keturunan kepada orang yang mandul.

lines.ar: أَمَرْتُكَ الخَيْرَ لَكِنْ مَا ائْتَمَرْتُ بِهِ ٭ وَمَا اسْتَقَمْتُ فَمَا قَوْليِ لَكَ اسْتَقِمِ
lines.translit: Amartukal khayra lākin māʾtamartu bihi ٭ Wa māstaqamtu famā qawlī lakastaqimi

tr.en: I enjoined goodness upon you while failing to heed the same. ٭ I was not upright, so what use is my enjoining uprightness?
tr.enSingable: I've ordered you to do good, but have ignored it, myself; ٭ I'm not upstanding, so who am I to tell you to be?
tr.id: Engkau kuperintah lakukan amal kebajikan, namun diriku sendiri tak mengerjakannya. ٭ Apa gunanya perintahku jika aku tak menjalankan?

lines.ar: وَلاَ تَزَوَّدْتُ قَبْلَ المَوْتِ نَافِلَةً ٭ وَلَمْ أُصَلِّ سِوَى فَرْضٍ وَلَمْ أَصُمِ
lines.translit: Wa lā tazawwadtu qablal mawti nāfīlatan ٭ Wa lam uṣalli siwā farḍin wa lam aṣumi

tr.en: I have not gathered provisions of voluntary prayers before death, ٭ or prayed and fasted beyond what is obligatory.
tr.enSingable: I haven't packed extra deeds in preparation for death; ٭ I haven't prayed, haven't fasted, but the compulsory.
tr.id: Dan aku tidak mempersiapkan tambahan bekal amal sunnah sebelum ajal menjemput. ٭ Tidak pula aku shalat dan puasa, melainkan hanya ibadah wajib saja.

lines.ar: الفصل ٣
ظَلَمْتُ سُنَّةَ مَنْ أَحْيَا الظَّلاَمَ إِلَى ٭ أَنِ اشْتَكَتْ قَدَمَاهُ الضُّرَّ مِنْ وَرَمِ
lines.translit: Ẓalamtu sunnata man aḥyādh ẓalāma ilā ٭ Anishtakat qadamāhuḍ ḍurra min warami

tr.en: I have wronged the Sunna of him who enlivened the dark nights ٭ By praying till his feet complained of painful swelling.
tr.enSingable: I've violated the way of him who livened the dark, ٭ Until his feet had complained of swelling up painfully;
tr.id: Kutinggalkan sunnah Baginda Nabi ﷺ yang selalu menghidupkan gelapnya malam ٭ dengan ibadah hingga kedua kaki beliau terasa sakit sebab membengkak.

lines.ar: وَشَدَّ مِنْ سَغَبٍ أَحْشَاءَهُ وَطَوَى ٭ تَحْتَ الحِجَارَةِ كَشْحًا مُتْرَفَ الأَدَمِ
lines.translit: Wa shadda min saghabin aḥshāʾahu wa ṭawā ٭ Taḥtal ḥijārati kash-ḥan mutrafal adami

tr.en: He placed a stone over his belly and soft skin, ٭ Tightening a belt over it to diminish the hunger pangs.
tr.enSingable: And out of hunger, would bind his abdomen and would wrap ٭ Beneath a hard stone a waist whose skin is so velvety.
tr.id: Baginda Nabi ﷺ mengikat perut sebab dahsyatnya rasa lapar yang diderita. ٭ Beliau lipat kulit pinggang beliau yang begitu halus dengan batu.

lines.ar: وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الجِبَالُ الشُّمُّ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ ٭ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَأَرَاهَا أَيَّمَا شَمَمِ
lines.translit: Wa rāwadat-hul jibālush shummu min dhahabin ٭ ʿAn nafsihi fa arāhā ayyamā shamami

tr.en: Lofty mountains tried, to tempt him with turning to gold, ٭ But he showed them the height of his own loftiness!
tr.enSingable: The lofty mountains made into gold for him tried to be ٭ A way to bait him, so he true loftiness let them see.
tr.id: Gunung menjulang tinggi pun menawarkan menjadi emas untuk Baginda Nabi ﷺ. ٭ Namun beliau tolak dan beliau perlihatkan ketidakbutuhan beliau dengan penuh rasa bangga.

lines.ar: وَأَكَّدَتْ زُهْدَهُ فِيهَا ضَرُورَتُهُ ٭ إِنَّ الضَّرُورَةَ لاَ تَعْدُو عَلَى العِصَمِ
lines.translit: Wa akkadat zuhdahu fīhā ḍarūratuhu ٭ Innaḍ ḍarūrata lā taʿdū ʿalal ʿiṣami

tr.en: His dire neediness only strengthened his detachment; ٭ neediness like his never leads to transgression.
tr.enSingable: His "poverty" only strengthened his disinterest in them; ٭ For never are protectees assaulted by poverty.
tr.id: Keadaan darurat butuh harta namun enggan menerima inilah yang menguatkan & membuktikan kezuhudan Baginda Nabi ﷺ.  Beliau sungguh zuhud, tidak menerima harta itu. ٭ Meskipun jika menerimanya dalam keadaan butuh, hal itu tak akan merusak nilai kemaksuman beliau.

lines.ar: وَكَيْفَ تَدْعُو إِلَى الدُّنْيَا ضَرُورَةُ مَنْ ٭ لَوْلاَهُ لَمْ تُخْرَجِ الدُّنْيَا مِنَ العَدَمِ
lines.translit: Wa kayfa tadʿū ilad dunyā ḍarūratu man ٭ Lawlāhu lam tukhrajid dunyā minal ʿadami

tr.en: How could need tempt him with worldliness, when but for him ٭ The world would not have emerged from non-existence?
tr.enSingable: How could it tempt to this world-the "poverty" of him who ٭ If not for him, the whole world would not have been made to be.
tr.id: Bagaimana mungkin Baginda Nabi ﷺ dapat tergoda dengan gemerlap dunia,  ٭ sedangkan andai bukan karena beliau, niscaya dunia takkan pernah ada?

lines.ar: مُحَمَّدٌ سَيِّدُ الكَوْنَيْنِ وَالثَّقَلَيْـ ٭ ـنِ وَالفَرِيقَيْنِ مِنْ عُرْبٍ وَمِنْ عَجَمِ
lines.translit: Muḥammadun sayyidul kawnayni wath thaqalay- ٭ -ni wal farīqayni min ʿurbin wa min ʿajami

tr.en: Muhammad is the master of both abodes, of both kinds, ٭ And both classes [of people]: Arabs and non-Arabs.
tr.enSingable: Muhammad, the master of both worlds and both beings and ٭ Both groups: the Arabs and the non-Arab community;
tr.id: Nabi Muhammad ﷺ adalah pemimpin dunia akhirat, pemimpin manusia dan jin, ٭ juga pemimpin bangsa Arab dan non-Arab.

lines.ar: نَبِيُّنَا الآمِرُ النَّاهِي فَلاَ أَحَدٌ ٭ أَبَرَّ فِي قَوْلِ لاَ مِنْهُ وَلاَ نَعَمِ
lines.translit: Nabiyyunal āmirun nāhī falā aḥadun ٭ Abarra fī qawli lā minhu wa lā naʿami

tr.en: Our Prophet, who commands and who forbids; ٭ None is more true than him in saying “yes” or “no”.
tr.enSingable: Our prophet, who is commander and forbidder-there is ٭ No one more true in his saying no or yes than is he.
tr.id: Nabi kita, Muhammad ﷺ, adalah rasul yang memerintahkan kebajikan dan mencegah kemungkaran. ٭ Tidak ada seorang pun yang lebih baik perkataannya daripada Baginda Nabi ﷺ saat menolak dengan berkata 'jangan' dan saat diminta dengan berkata 'ya'.

lines.ar: هُوَ الحَبِيبُ الذِّي تُرْجَى شَفَاعَتُهُ ٭ لِكُلِّ هَوْلٍ مِنَ الأَهْوَالِ مُقْتَحَمِ
lines.translit: Huwal ḥabībul ladhī turjā shafāʿatuhu ٭ Li kulli hawlin minal ahwāli muqtaḥami

tr.en: He is the Beloved whose intercession is hoped for, ٭ Victorious over every terror and disaster.
tr.enSingable: He is the loved one whose intercession we're hopeful of, ٭ At every horror to hit-yes, every calamity.
tr.id: Beliaulah sang Kekasih Allah yang sangat diharapkan syafaat beliau ٭ dari setiap keadaan mencekam pada saat genting.

lines.ar: دَعَا إِلَى اللهِ فَالْمُسْتَمْسِكُونَ بِهِ ٭ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ بِحَبْلٍ غَيْرِ مُنْفَصِمِ
lines.translit: Daʿā ilaLlāhi fal mustamsikūna bihi ٭ Mustamsikūna biḥablin ghayri munfaṣimi

tr.en: He called [people] to Allah, so those who hold fast to him ٭ Are holding fast to a rope that never shall break.
tr.enSingable: He has invited to God, so all who grip onto him ٭ Are gripping rope that will never fray for eternity.
tr.id: Baginda Nabi ﷺ mengajak menuju agama Allah. Berpegangteguhlah padanya. ٭ Karena orang yang berpegang teguh padanya, sungguh, ia telah berpegang teguh pada tali Allah yang takkan putus.

lines.ar: فَاقَ النَبِيّينَ فِي خَلْقٍ وَفِي خُلُقٍ ٭ وَلَمْ يُدَانُوهُ فِي عِلْمٍ وَلاَ كَرَمِ
lines.translit: Fāqan nabiyyīna fī khalqin wa fī khuluqin ٭ Wa lam yudānūhu fī ʿilmin wa lā karami

tr.en: He excelled the other Prophets in form and qualities; ٭ Their knowledge and nobility did not come near his.
tr.enSingable: He tops the prophets in both appearance and character; ٭ They don't approach him in knowledge or in gen'rosity.
tr.id: Baginda Nabi ﷺ mengungguli para nabi lain dalam segi ketampanan zahir serta luhurnya budi pekerti. ٭ Mereka tiada yang dapat menyamai Baginda Nabi ﷺ dalam keilmuan maupun kemuliaan beliau.

lines.ar: وَكُلُّهُمْ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ مُلْتَمِسٌ ٭ غَرْفًا مِنَ البَحْرِ أَوْ رَشْفًا مِنَ الدِّيَمِ
lines.translit: Wa kulluhum min rasūliLlāhi multamisun ٭ Gharfan minal baḥri aw rashfan minad diyami

tr.en: They all seek something from Allah’s Emissary – ٭ handfuls from the sea, or small sips of drizzle.
tr.enSingable: And all of them are receiving from Allah's Messenger ٭ A sip from down-pouring rain or handful scooped from the sea.
tr.id: Mereka semua mengambil dari Baginda Nabi ﷺ ٭ seciduk lautan maupun seteguk air hujan dari ilmu beliau.

lines.ar: وَوَاقِفُونَ لَدَيْهِ عِنْدَ حَدِّهِمِ ٭ مِنْ نُقْطَةِ العِلْمِ أَوْ مِنْ شَكْلَةِ الحِكَمِ
lines.translit: Wa wāqifūna ladayhi ʿinda ḥaddihimi ٭ Min nuqṭatil ʿilmi aw min shaklatil ḥikami

tr.en: They all stand before him, observing their limits; ٭ Dots to his knowledge, or vowel-marks to his wisdom.
tr.enSingable: And all are standing before him at their own limits fixed: ٭ A dot of knowledge or mark from words of sagacity.
tr.id: Di hadapan Baginda Nabi ﷺ, mereka para nabi berhenti pada batas puncaknya, ٭ baik dalam setitik ilmu ataupun sebentuk hikmah.

lines.ar: فَهْوَ الذِّي تَمَّ مَعْنَاهُ وَصُورَتُهُ ٭ ثُمَّ اصْطَفَاهُ حَبِيبًا بَارِئُ النَّسَمِ
lines.translit: Fa huwal ladhī tamma maʿnāhu wa ṣūratuhu ٭ Thummaṣṭafāhu ḥabīban bāriʾun nasami

tr.en: It is he whose meaning and form attained perfection ٭ Then the Maker of Souls chose him for His beloved.
tr.enSingable: He is the one with perfected essence and outward form; ٭ Picked as the love of the Maker of all humanity.
tr.id: Beliaulah nabi yang sempurna batin dan zahirnya. ٭ Tuhan Sang Pencipta pun memilih beliau sebagai kekasih.

lines.ar: مُنَزَّهٌ عَنْ شَرِيكٍ فِي مَحَاسِنِهِ ٭ فَجَوْهَرُ الحُسْنِ  فِيهِ غَيْرُ مُنْقَسِمِ
lines.translit: Munazzahun ʿan sharīkin fī maḥāsinihi ٭ Fa jawharul ḥusni fīhi ghayru munqasimi

tr.en: Exalted above having a rival in his perfections; ٭ In him is the undivided essence of beauty.
tr.enSingable: Beyond a partner in his so beautiful qualities; ٭ Yes, undivided in him is beauty's whole entity.
tr.id: Baginda Nabi ﷺ suci dari persamaan dalam berbagai kebaikan beliau. ٭ Intisari kebaikan Baginda Nabi ﷺ tak dapat terbagi.

lines.ar: دَعْ مَا ادَّعَتْهُ النَّصَارَى فِي نَبِيِّهِمِ ٭ وَاحْكُمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ مَدْحًا فِيهِ وَاحْتَكِمِ
lines.translit: Daʿ maddaʿat-hun naṣārā fī nabiyyihimi ٭ Waḥkum bimā shiʾta mad-ḥan fīhi waḥtakimi

tr.en: Eschew the claim Christians have made for their Prophet. ٭ Then say in his praise what you will, but wisely!
tr.enSingable: Avoid what Christians have claimed about their own messenger; ٭ And give to him any praise you wish, and praise sensibly.
tr.id: Tinggalkanlah sanjungan kaum Nasrani pada nabi mereka. ٭ Tetapkanlah pujian bagi Baginda Nabi ﷺ sesuka hatimu, serta bijaklah dalam menyanjung.

lines.ar: وَانْسُبْ إِلَى ذَاتِهِ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَرَفٍ ٭ وَانْسُبْ إِلَى قَدْرِهِ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ عِظَمِ
lines.translit: Wansub ilā dhātihi mā shiʾta min sharafin ٭ Wansub ilā qadrihi mā shiʾta min ʿiẓami

tr.en: Ascribe whatever honour you will to his essence, ٭ And ascribe what greatness you will to his worth;
tr.enSingable: Ascribe to his person what you wish of nobility; ٭ Ascribe to his stature what you wish of immensity.
tr.id: Nisbahkanlah sesukamu segala kemuliaan kepada Baginda Nabi ﷺ. ٭ Sematkanlah segala keagungan derajat kepada beliau sekehendakmu.

lines.ar: فَإِنَّ فَضْلَ رَسُولِ اللهِ لَيْسَ لَهُ ٭ حَدٌّ  فَيُعْرِبَ عَنْهُ نَاطِقٌ بِفَمِ
lines.translit: Fa inna faḍla rasūliLlāhi laysa lahu ٭ Ḥaddun fa yuʿriba ʿanhu nāṭiqun bifami

tr.en: For the worth of Allah’s Emissary has no limit ٭ That could be expressed by a human mouth.
tr.enSingable: Indeed, Allah's Messenger's perfection has no frontier ٭ That any speaker could ever verbalize orally.
tr.id: Sungguh, keutamaan Baginda Nabi ﷺ tak ada ٭ batasnya. Lisan pun tak mampu mengungkapkan dengan kata.

lines.ar: لَوْ نَاسَبَتْ قَدْرَهُ آيَاتُهُ عِظَمًا ٭ أَحْيَا اسْمُهُ حِينَ يُدْعَى دَارِسَ الرِّمَمِ
lines.translit: Law nāsabat qadrahu āyātuhu ʿiẓaman ٭ Aḥyaʾsmuhu ḥīna yudʿā dārisar rimami

tr.en: If his miracles were commensurate with his greatness, ٭ The mere mention of his name would give life to dry bones.
tr.enSingable: And were his marvels to match his worth in greatness, his name, ٭ When called, would give life to bones decayed to nihility.
tr.id: Andai keagungan mukjizat Baginda Nabi ﷺ dapat menyamai derajat beliau yang tinggi, ٭ niscaya orang yang telah binasa dan hancur tulang-belulangnya seketika hidup tatkala disebut nama beliau.

lines.ar: لَمْ يَمْتَحِنَّا بِمَا تَعْيَا الْعُقُولُ بِهِ ٭ حِرْصًا عَلَيْنَا فَلَمْ نَرْتَبْ وَلَمْ نَهِمْ
lines.translit: Lam yamtaḥinnā bimā taʿyal ʿuqūlu bihi ٭ Ḥirṣan ʿalayna falam nartab wa lam nahimi

tr.en: He did not try us with things that confound the mind ٭ Out of concern for us, so we neither doubted nor strayed.
tr.enSingable: He tried us not, from concern, with things that boggle the mind; ٭ And so we haven't faced any doubt or perplexity.
tr.id: Baginda Nabi ﷺ tidak menguji kita dengan hal yang tidak terjangkau oleh akal ٭ karena kecintaan beliau agar kita mendapat petunjuk. Kita pun yakin, tidak ragu dan tidak bingung.

lines.ar: أَعْيَا الوَرَى فَهْمُ مَعْنَاهُ فَلَيْسَ يُرَى ٭ فِي القُرْبِ وَالْبُعْدِ فِيهِ غَيْرُ مُنْفَحِمِ
lines.translit: Aʿyal warā fahmu maʿnāhu falaysa yurā ٭ Fīl qurbi wal buʿdi fīhi ghayru munfaḥimi

tr.en: Man’s mind is exhausted trying to understand his meaning; ٭ All of them, near or far, appear as if dumbstruck.
tr.enSingable: Conceiving his meaning has exhausted the universe; ٭ So near or far, one not dumbstruck by it you will not see.
tr.id: Semua makhluk lemah tak mampu memahami hakikat Baginda Nabi ﷺ. Tak seorang pun bisa mengenal beliau ٭ dari dekat maupun dari jauh, kecuali berdiam diri tak berdaya.

lines.ar: كَالشَّمْسِ تَظْهَرُ لِلْعَيْنَيْنِ مِنْ بُعُدٍ ٭ صَغِيرَةً وَتُكِلُّ الطَّرْفَ مِنْ أَمَمِ
lines.translit: Kash shamsi taẓ-haru lil ʿaynayni min buʿudin ٭ Ṣaghīratan wa tukilluṭ ṭarfa min amami

tr.en: He is like the sun: small to the eye when seen from afar, ٭ But dazzling to the sight when seen close up.
tr.enSingable: Much like the sun: from afar it does appear small to eyes, ٭ And would impair any vision when in proximity.
tr.id: Baginda Nabi ﷺ bagai mentari, terlihat kecil oleh kedua mata dari jarak jauh. ٭ Namun saat berdekatan, mata takkan mampu memandang beliau.

lines.ar: وَكَيْفَ يُدْرِكُ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَقِيقَتَهُ ٭ قَوْمٌ نِيَامٌ تَسَلَّوْا عَنْهُ بِالحُلُمِ
lines.translit: Wa kayfa yudriku fid dunyā ḥaqīqatahu ٭ Qawmun niyāmun tasallū ʿanhu bil ḥulumi

tr.en: How can his reality be grasped in this world ٭ By sleeping folk, distracted from him by dreams?
tr.enSingable: And how could people asleep, distracted from him by dreams, ٭ Begin to grasp in the present world his reality!
tr.id: Bagaimana mungkin hakikat Baginda Nabi ﷺ dapat diketahui manusia di dunia ini, ٭ sedangkan mereka sudah merasa puas berjumpa dengan beliau hanya di alam mimpi?

lines.ar: فَمَبْلَغُ العِلْمِ فِيهِ أَنَّهُ بَشَرٌ ٭ وَأَنَّهُ خَيْرُ خَلْقِ اللهِ كُلِّهِمِ
lines.translit: Fa mablaghul ʿilmi fīhi annahu basharun ٭ Wa annahu khayru khalqiLlāhi kullihimi

tr.en: The extent of our knowledge is that he is a mortal – ٭ And that he is the best of Allah’s creation!
tr.enSingable: The peak of knowledge about him is that he is a man ٭ And is the best of Allah's creation, entirely.
tr.id: Puncak pengetahuan tentang Baginda Nabi ﷺ bahwa beliau adalah manusia. ٭ Akan tetapi, beliau adalah makhluk terbaik di antara semua makhluk Allah.

lines.ar: وَكُلُّ آيٍ أَتَى الرُّسْلُ الكِرَامُ بِهَا ٭ فَإِنَّمَا اتَّصَلَتْ مِنْ نُوِرِهِ بِهِمِ
lines.translit: Wa kullu āyin atar ruslul kirāmu bihā ٭ Fa innamat taṣalat min nūrihi bihimi

tr.en: Every miracle produced by the noble Emissaries ٭ Came to them by virtue of his light alone
tr.enSingable: And all the marvels the noble messengers have conveyed ٭ Have come to them from the light of Ahmad exclusively.
tr.id: Semua mukjizat yang dimiliki para rasul mulia ٭ tidak lain karena terhubung dengan cahaya Baginda Nabi ﷺ.

lines.ar: فَإِنَّهُ شَمْسُ فَضْلٍ هُمْ كَوَاكِبُهَا ٭ يُظْهِرْنَ أَنْوَارَهاَ لِلنَّاسِ فِي الظُّلَمِ
lines.translit: Fa innahu shamsu faḍlin hum kawākibuhā ٭ Yuẓ-hirna anwārahā lin nāsi fidh ẓulami

tr.en: For he is the sun of virtue, and they are its planets; ٭ They display its lights to mankind in the darkness.
tr.enSingable: He is the Sun of esteem, to which they are as if moons: ٭ Reflecting its lights in darknesses to humanity.
tr.id: Baginda Nabi ﷺ laksana matahari kemuliaan, sedangkan para nabi bagaikan bintang-bintang siarah. ٭ Bintang siarah memancarkan cahaya matahari untuk manusia saat gelap gulita.

lines.ar: أَكْرِمْ بِخَلْقِ نَبِيٍ زَانَهُ خُلُقٌ ٭ بِالحُسْنِ مُشْتَمِلٍ بِالبِشْرِ مُتَّسِمِ
lines.translit: Akrim bikhalqi nabiyyin zānahu khuluqun ٭ Bil ḥusni mushtamilin bil bishri muttasimi

tr.en: How noble the qualities of a Prophet beautified by such traits: ٭ Full of beauty, and marked by smiles and good cheer!
tr.enSingable: How grand the form of a Prophet brightened by character, ٭ Enveloped by handsomeness, distinguished by jollity!
tr.id: Alangkah indah rupa Baginda Nabi ﷺ yang dihiasi dengan akhlak mulia. ٭ Beliau mencakup segala bentuk keindahan serta bersifat murah senyum nan wajah manis berseri.

lines.ar: كَالزَّهْرِ فِي تَرَفٍ وَالبَدْرِ فِي شَرَفٍ ٭ وَالبَحْرِ فِي كَرَمٍ وَالدَّهْرِ فِي هِمَمِ
lines.translit: Kaz zahri fī tarafin wal badri fī sharafin ٭ Wal baḥri fī karamin wad dahri fī himami

tr.en: Like flowers in delicate beauty, like the full moon in honour; ٭ like the sea in generosity, like time in persistence.
tr.enSingable: Like flowers in fineness, the full moon in ascendancy, ٭ The ocean in giving, and all time in tenacity.
tr.id: Keindahan beliau laksana bunga, kemuliaan beliau bak bulan purnama, ٭ kedermawanan beliau bagaikan samudra, dan cita-cita beliau seperti perjalanan masa.

lines.ar: كَأَنَّه وَهْوَ فَرْدٌ مِنْ جَلاَلَتِهِ ٭ فِي عَسْكَرٍ حِينَ تَلْقَاهُ وَفِي حَشَمِ
lines.translit: Ka annahu wa huwa fardun min jalālatihi ٭ Fī ʿaskarin ḥīna talqāhu wa fī ḥashami

tr.en: So majestic was his presence that even when alone ٭ he appeared surrounded by a large army and retinue.
tr.enSingable: When he's alone and you meet him, he is like one amid ٭ An army and entourage, because of his majesty.
tr.id: Saat menjumpai Baginda Nabi ﷺ sendirian, seakan-akan kau berhadapan dengan tentara besar atau bertemu ٭ dengan para ajudan beliau, padahal beliau sedang sendirian. Ini sebab besarnya wibawa dan kemuliaan Baginda Nabi ﷺ.

lines.ar: كَأَنَّمَا اللُّؤْلُؤْ المَكْنُونُ فِي صَدَفٍ ٭ مِنْ مَعْدِنَيْ مَنْطِقٍ مِنْهُ وَمُبْتَسِمِ
lines.translit: Ka annamal luʾluʾul maknūnu fī ṣadafin ٭ Min maʿdinay manṭiqin minhu wa mubtasami

tr.en: It is as if precious hidden pearls, sparkling from their shells, ٭ came from the treasure-mine of his speech and smile.
tr.enSingable: From treasure chests of his eloquence and his beaming grin ٭ Do seem to be pearls preserved within their shells preciously.
tr.id: Seakan mutiara indah yang tersembunyi dalam kerangnya ٭ bersumber dari untaian kata dan senyuman Baginda Nabi ﷺ.

lines.ar: لاَ طِيبَ يَعْدِلُ تُرْبًا ضَمَّ أَعْظُمَهُ ٭ طُوبىَ لِمُنْتَشِقٍ مِنْهُ وَمُلْتَثِمِ
lines.translit: Lā ṭība yaʿdilu turban ḍamma aʿẓumahu ٭ Ṭūbā li muntashiqin minhu wa multathimi

tr.en: No perfume can match the ground that holds his bones. ٭ Blessed are those who breathe in its fragrance or kiss it!
tr.enSingable: No scent compares to the earth embracing his blessed form; ٭ For him who sniffs it or kisses it what felicity!
tr.id: Tiada wewangian dapat menandingi semerbak harum tanah yang menyimpan jasad mulia Baginda Nabi ﷺ. ٭ Alangkah bahagia, orang yang mencium & mengecupnya.

lines.ar: الفصل ٤
أَبَانَ مَوْلِدُهُ عَنْ طِيبِ عُنْصُرِهِ ٭ يَا طِيبَ مُبْتَدَإٍ مِنْهُ وَمُخْتَتَمِ
lines.translit: Abāna mawliduhu ʿan ṭībi ʿunṣurihi ٭ Yā ṭība mubtadaʾin minhu wa mukhtatami

tr.en: His birth made the purity of his pedigree evident; ٭ O how pure were his beginning and his end!
tr.enSingable: His noble birth did reveal the purity of his roots. ٭ How pure the outset of them as well as finality!
tr.id: Kelahiran Baginda Nabi ﷺ menunjukkan kesucian unsur beliau. ٭ Betapa indah permulaan maupun penghujungnya.

lines.ar: يَوْمٌ تَفَرَّسَ فِيهِ الفُرْسُ أَنَّهُمُ ٭ قَدْ أُنْذِرُوا بِحُلُولِ البُؤْسِ وَالنِّقَمِ
lines.translit: Yawmun tafarrasa fīhil fursu annahumu ٭ Qad undhirū biḥulūlil buʾsi wan niqami

tr.en: On that day the Persians intuited that they ٭ Had been warned of looming misery and retribution.
tr.enSingable: How pure the outset of them as well as finality! ٭ Of the occurrence of suffering and adversity.
tr.id: Hari kelahiran Baginda Nabi ﷺ adalah hari di mana bangsa Persia ٭ telah diingatkan para ahli nujum bahwa mereka akan ditimpa malapetaka dan siksa.

lines.ar: وَبَاتَ إِيوَانُ كِسْرَى وَهُوَ مُنْصَدِعٌ ٭ كَشَمْلِ أَصْحَابِ كِسْرَى غَيْرَ مُلْتَئِمِ
lines.translit: Wa bāta īwānu kisrā wa huwa munṣadiʿun ٭ Ka shamli aṣ-ḥābi kisrā ghayra multaʾimi

tr.en: That night the throne room of Khusraw became cracked, ٭ Khusraw’s people, too, crumbled, never to be restored.
tr.enSingable: The Arch of Khosrau had passed the night while falling apart; ٭ Just like the status of Khosrau's peers: without unity.
tr.id: Pada malam itu, istana Kisra runtuh hancur terbelah, ٭ sebagaimana terpecah-belahnya pasukan Kisra yang tak dapat menyatu kembali.

lines.ar: وَالنَّارُ خَامِدَةُ الأَنْفَاسِ مِنْ أَسَفٍ ٭ عَلَيْهِ وَالنَّهْرُ سَاهِي العَيْنِ مِنْ سَدَمِ
lines.translit: Wan nāru khāmidatul anfāsi min asafin ٭ ʿAlayhi wan nahru sāhil ʿayni min sadami

tr.en: The sacred fire, grief-stricken, breathed its last, ٭ And the river [Euphrates] dried up out of worry.
tr.enSingable: The fire was short of breath out of regret over it. ٭ The river lost all its current out of despondency.
tr.id: Kobaran api sesembahan bangsa Persia padam akan kesedihan yang mendalam. ٭ Sungai pun berhenti mengalir sebab pedihnya duka.

lines.ar: وَسَاءَ سَاوَةَ أَنْ غَاضَتْ بُحَيْرَتُهَا ٭ وَرُدَّ وَارِدُهَا بِالغَيْظِ حِينَ ظَمِي
lines.translit: Wa sāʾa sāwata an ghāḍat buḥayratuhā ٭ Wa rudda wāriduhā bil ghayẓi ḥīna ẓamī

tr.en: Sāʾa was saddened by its lake drying up; ٭ the thirsty who went to drink there came back in a rage!
tr.enSingable: It saddened Sawa to find the drying up of its lake, ٭ And thirsty seekers returning from the place angrily.
tr.id: Penduduk kawasan danau Sawah bersedih ketika danaunya mengering. ٭ Orang yang mendatanginya untuk mengambil air pun kembali dalam keadaan marah saat terjerat dahaga.

lines.ar: كَأَنَّ بِالنَّارِ مَا بِالمَاءِ مِنْ بَلَلٍ ٭ حُزْنًا وَبِالمَاءِ مَا بِالنَّارِ مِنْ ضَرَمِ
lines.translit: Ka anna bin nāri mā bil māʾi min balalin ٭ Ḥuznan wa bil māʾi mā bin nāri min ḍarami

tr.en: As if the fire, from sorrow, took on the water’s wetness ٭ And water assumed the fire’s quality of blazing.
tr.enSingable: As if the fire had gotten water's wetness from grief; ٭ And water had burnt up as a fire burns seethingly.
tr.id: Karena duka yang mencekam, seakan-akan pada api bangsa Persia yang padam tersebut ada air danau Sawah, ٭ sedangkan dalam air danau yang kering itu terdapat api yang menyala.

lines.ar: وَالجِنُّ تَهْتِفُ وَالأَنْوَارُ سَاطِعَةٌ ٭ وَالحَّقُ يَظْهَرُ مِنْ مَعْنىً وَمِنْ كَلِمِ
lines.translit: Wal jinnu tahtifu wal anwāru sāṭiʿatun ٭ Wal ḥaqqu yaẓ-haru min maʿnan wa min kalimi

tr.en: There were jinn calling out, and dazzling lights ٭ As truth was manifested in both word and reality.
tr.enSingable: The jinn were speaking aloud, and lights were shining so bright; ٭ The Truth is made manifest in signal and verbally.
tr.id: Para jin menjerit. Cahaya terpancar tinggi ke angkasa. ٭ Dan kebenaran atas kenabian beliau tersingkap jelas dari makna maupun kata.

lines.ar: عَمُوا وَصَمُّوا فَإِعْلاَنُ البَشَائِرِ لَمْ ٭ يُسْمَعْ وَبَارِقَةُ الإِنْذَارِ لَمْ تُشَمِ
lines.translit: ʿAmmū wa ṣammū fa iʿlānul bashāʾiri lam ٭ Yusmaʿ wa bāriqatul indhāri lam tushami

tr.en: They were blind and deaf, so the glad tidings proclaimed ٭ Went unheard, and the warning lightning-flash was not seen.
tr.enSingable: But blind and deaf they were so the happy news went unheard; ٭ And flashes of lightning as a warning they didn't see.
tr.id: Mereka menjadi buta dan tuli. Kabar gembira kelahiran Baginda Nabi ﷺ pun tak ٭ dapat mereka dengar, juga kilatan peringatan tak mereka lihat.

lines.ar: مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَخْبَرَ الأَقْوَامَ كَاهِنُهُمْ ٭ بِأَنَّ دِينَهُمُ المُعْوَجَّ لَمْ يَقُمِ
lines.translit: Min baʿdi mā akhbaral aqwāma kāhinuhum ٭ Bi anna dīnahumul muʿwajja lam yaqumi

tr.en: Even after the soothsayers had informed their peoples ٭ That their crooked religion would not endure,
tr.enSingable: All after their fortune teller notified all the folk ٭ Their old religion so crooked soon would no longer be.
tr.id: Mereka buta dan tuli setelah diberi kabar oleh para rahib ٭ bahwa agama mereka melenceng sesat dan tak akan bertahan abadi.

lines.ar: وَبَعْدَمَا عَايَنُوا فِي الأُفْقِ مِنْ شُهُبٍ ٭ مُنْقَضَّةٍ وَفْقَ مَا فِي الأَرْضَ مِنْ صَنَمِ
lines.translit: Wa baʿda mā ʿāyanū fīl ufqi min shuhubin ٭ Munqaḍḍatin wifqa mā fīl arḍi min ṣanami

tr.en: And even after their eyes saw meteors on the horizon ٭ Plunging downwards, as idols were toppled on earth;
tr.enSingable: And after they eyed in the horizons the shooting stars ٭ All crashing like statues in the earth for idolatry.
tr.id: Dan setelah mereka saksikan bintang-bintang  di ufuk langit ٭ berjatuhan bertepatan dengan hancurnya berhala-berhala sesembahan di bumi.

lines.ar: حَتَّى غَدَا عَنْ طَرِيقِ الْوَحْيِ مُنْهَزِمٌ ٭ مِنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ يَقْفُوا إِثْرَ مُنْهَزِمِ
lines.translit: Ḥattā ghadā ʿan ṭarīqil waḥyī munhazimun ٭ Minash shayāṭīni yaqfū ithra munhazimi

tr.en: Until devils, routed, from the path of revelation, ٭ Fled in the wake of those who had been overpowered.
tr.enSingable: Until from the source of revelation, up in the sky, ٭ One after the other, each retreating demon did flee.
tr.id: Hingga para setan kabur terbirit-birit meninggalkan pintu langit, jalan wahyu ilahi. ٭ Mereka mengekor jejak setan yang lari tak henti-henti.

lines.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ هَرَبًا أَبْطَالُ أَبْرَهَةٍ ٭ أَوْ عَسْكَرٍ بِالحَصَى مِنْ رَاحَتَيْهِ رُمِي
lines.translit: Ka annahum haraban abṭālu abrahatin ٭ Aw ʿaskarin bil ḥaṣā min rāḥatayhi rumī

tr.en: Fleeing like the brave warriors of Abraha ٭ Or the army pelted by pebbles thrown by his hand,
tr.enSingable: They were when fleeing just like the heroes of Abrahah, ٭ Or like a pelted-with-pebbles-from-his-hands infantry.
tr.id: Para setan berlarian, sebagaimana panglima tentara Abrahah ٭ atau pasukan musuh yang lari dilempari kerikil oleh tangan mulia Baginda Nabi ﷺ.

lines.ar: نَبْذًا بِهِ بَعْدَ تَسْبِيحٍ بِبَطْنِهِمَا ٭ نَبْذَ المُسَبِّحِ مِنْ أَحْشَاءِ مُلْتَقِمِ
lines.translit: Nabdhan bihi baʿda tasbīḥin bi baṭnihimā ٭ Nabdhal musabbiḥi min aḥshāʾi multaqimi

tr.en: Cast by him after glorifying Allah in the palm of his hand, ٭ As he who glorified his Lord was cast from the whale.
tr.enSingable: Hurled after having extolled while in the palms of his hands; ٭ Hurled like the swallowed extoller from the gut cavity.
tr.id: Batu kerikil dilemparkan Baginda Nabi ﷺ setelah bertasbih dalam genggaman kedua tangan mulia beliau. ٭ Ini bagaikan terlemparnya Nabi Yunus n dari perut ikan paus setelah bertasbih di dalamnya.

lines.ar: الفصل ٥
جَاءَتْ لِدَعْوَتِهِ الأَشْجَارُ سَاجِدَةً ٭ تَمْشِي إِلَيْهِ عَلَى سَاقٍ بِلاَ قَدَمِ
lines.translit: Jāʾat li daʿwatihil ashjāru sājidatan ٭ Tamshī ilayhi ʿalā sāqin bilā qadami

tr.en: Trees came prostrating to him when he called, ٭ Walking towards him on trunks without feet
tr.enSingable: The trees had come for his call, prostrate in humility; ٭ They came to him on their trunks, like footless legs, walking free.
tr.id: Pepohonan datang memenuhi seruan Baginda Nabi ﷺ dengan tunduk. ٭ Mereka berjalan menuju beliau dengan batang tanpa telapak kaki.

lines.ar: كَأَنَّمَا سَطَرَتْ سَطْرًا لِمَا كَتَبَتْ ٭ فُرُوعُهَا مِنْ بَدِيعِ الْخَطِّ بِاللَّقَمِ
lines.translit: Ka annamā saṭarat saṭran limā katabat ٭ Furūʿuhā min badīʿil khaṭṭi bil laqami

tr.en: As though they had inscribed lines of splendid calligraphy ٭ With their branches along the path.
tr.enSingable: As if they had drawn along the way a straight line for what ٭ Their branches had written in the finest calligraphy.
tr.id: Pepohonan itu seakan-akan sedang menulis di tengah jalan yang ia lalui ٭ dengan ranting-rantingnya tulisan yang sangat indah.

lines.ar: مِثْلَ الغَمَامَةِ أَنَّى سَارَ سَائِرَةً ٭ تَقِيهِ حَرَّ وَطِيسٍ لِلْهَجِيرِ حَمِي
lines.translit: Mithlal ghamāmati annā sāra sāʾiratan ٭ Taqīhi ḥarra waṭīsin lil hajīri ḥamī

tr.en: Like the cloud that hovered over him wherever he went, ٭ Shielding him from the intense oven of the midday heat.
tr.enSingable: Just like the cloud moving with him as he moved anywhere; ٭ From noon's intense oven heat protecting him constantly.
tr.id: Sebagaimana awan yang selalu mendampingi ke mana pun Baginda Nabi ﷺ pergi. ٭ Ia melindungi beliau dari teriknya sinar matahari di siang hari.

lines.ar: أَقْسَمْتُ بِالْقَمَرِ المُنْشَقِّ إِنَّ لَهُ ٭ مِنْ قَلْبِهِ نِسْبَةً مَبْرُورَةَ القَسَمِ
lines.translit: Aqsamtu bil qamaril munshaqqi inna lahu ٭ Min qalbihi nisbatan mabrūratal qasami

tr.en: I swear by the [Lord of the] moon that was split in two ٭ a true oath: it has truly a connection with his heart.
tr.enSingable: I swear an oath by the moon, which split in two, that it has ٭ A likeness to his pure heart-an oath of veracity.
tr.id: Aku bersumpah demi Dzat Pencipta bulan yang pecah. Aku bersumpah dengan sumpah yang terlaksana, ٭ sesungguhnya, hati Baginda Nabi ﷺ terbelah bagaikan terbelahnya bulan.

lines.ar: وَمَا حَوَى الغَارُ مِنْ خَيْرٍ وَمِنْ كَرَمِ ٭ وَكُلُّ طَرْفٍ مِنَ الكُفَّارِ عَنْهُ عَمِي
lines.translit: Wa mā ḥawal ghāru min khayrin wa min karamin ٭ Wa kullu ṭarfin minal kuffāri ʿanhu ʿamī

tr.en: And by the goodness and nobility contained in the cave ٭ While the disbelievers’ every glance was blind to him.
tr.enSingable: And what the cave did contain of good and nobility; ٭ With every look from the disbelievers too blind to see.
tr.id: Gua Tsur mendekap dan menjaga dua insan mulia, Baginda Nabi ﷺ dan Abu Bakar ash-Shiddiq. ٭ Seluruh mata orang kafir buta tak dapat menemukan mereka berdua.

lines.ar: فَالصِّدْقُ فِي الغَارِ وَالصِّدِّيقُ لَمْ يَرِمَا ٭ وَهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا بِالْغَارِ مِنْ أَرِمِ
lines.translit: Faṣ ṣidqu fīl ghāri waṣ ṣiddīqu lam yarimā ٭ Wa hum yaqūlūna mā bil ghāri min arimi

tr.en: Truthfulness and the True One in the cave wavered not ٭ While they said ‘No one who breathes is in the cave!’
tr.enSingable: The Truth and Truthful in Faith inside the cave hadn't moved; ٭ All while they were saying that inside the cave none could be.
tr.id: Baginda Nabi ﷺ dan Abu Bakar ash-Shiddiq masih berada di dalam gua. ٭ Akan tetapi, mereka orang kafir berkata, 'Tak ada seorang pun dalam gua ini'.

lines.ar: ظَنُّوا الحَمَامَ وَظَنُّوا الْعَنْكَبُوتَ عَلَى ٭ خَيْرِ الْبَرِيَّةِ لَمْ تَنْسُجْ وَلَمْ تَحُمِ
lines.translit: Ẓannul ḥamāma wa ẓannul ʿankabūta ʿalā ٭ Khayril bariyyati lam tansuj wa lam taḥumi

tr.en: They supposed that a dove would never perch, ٭ Or a spider would spin its web, for the Best of Creation
tr.enSingable: They thought no dove hovered and no spider spun any web, ٭ For him, the Best of Creation-thinking its vacancy.
tr.id: Mereka berfikir, apabila Baginda Nabi g-yang merupakan sebaik-baiknya makhluk itu-berada di dalam, ٭ tak mungkin dikelilingi burung merpati dan tak mungkin laba-laba menenun sarang di mulut gua.

lines.ar: وِقَايَةُ اللهِ أَغْنَتْ عَنْ مُضَاعَفَةٍ ٭ مِنَ الدُّرُوعِ وَعَنْ عَالٍ مِنَ الأُطُمِ
lines.translit: WiqāyatuLlāhi aghnat ʿan muḍāʿafatin ٭ Minad durūʿi wa ʿan ʿālin minal uṭumi

tr.en: Their protection by Allah absolved them of need ٭ for additional armour or for lofty fortresses.
tr.enSingable: Protection from God made needless reinforced armature, ٭ Or towering citadels providing security.
tr.id: Allah melindungi mereka berdua dengan Gua Tsur. Perlindungan Allah cukup bagi mereka ٭ hingga tidak membutuhkan berlapis-lapis baju besi dan benteng yang menjulang tinggi.

lines.ar: مَا سَامَنِي الدَّهْرُ ضَيْمًا وَاسْتَجَرْتُ بِهِ ٭ إِلاَّ وَنِلْتُ جِوَارًا مِنْهُ لَمْ يُضَمِ
lines.translit: Mā sāmanid dahru ḍayman wastajartu bihi ٭ Illā wa niltu jiwāran minhu lam yuḍami

tr.en: Never, when fate oppressed me, have I sought refuge in him ٭ but that I found sanctuary with him and was oppressed no more.
tr.enSingable: No day has time gone to harm me and I have sought his care, ٭ But that I have gotten care from him, without mockery.
tr.id: Tak pernah ada kezaliman menimpaku kemudian aku mohon perlindungan Baginda Nabi ﷺ, ٭ kecuali dari beliau aku mendapatkan pertolongan dan penjagaan tanpa sedikit pun disakiti.

lines.ar: وَلاَ الْتَمَسْتُ غِنَى الدَّارَيْنِ مِنْ يَدِهِ ٭ إِلاَّ اسْتَلَمْتُ النَّدَى مِنْ خَيْرِ مُسْتَلَمِ
lines.translit: Wa laltamastu ghinad dārayni min yadihi ٭ Illāstalamtun nadā min khayri mustalami

tr.en: And never have I sought wealth in both worlds from his hand ٭ Without receiving largesse from the best of givers.
tr.enSingable: Nor have I asked of the riches of both worlds from his hand, ٭ Without largesse from the best of givers coming to me.
tr.id: Aku tidak meminta kekayaan dunia dan akhirat dari tangan mulia Baginda Nabi ﷺ, ٭ melainkan aku akan mendapatkan sebaik-baik pemberian dari beliau, sang Nabi terbaik dalam memenuhi permintaan umatnya.

lines.ar: لاَ تُنْكِرِ الْوَحْيَ مِنْ رُؤْيَاهُ إِنَّ لَهُ ٭ قَلْبًا إِذَا نَامَتِ العَيْنَانِ لَمْ يَنَمِ
lines.translit: Lā tunkiril waḥya min ruʾyāhu inna lahu ٭ Qalban idhā nāmatil ʿaynāni lam yanami

tr.en: Do not deny the revelations he received in his dreams; ٭ For though his eyes slept, he had a heart that slept not.
tr.enSingable: Do not deny revelation from his dreaming, because ٭ His heart, though his eyes may shut, is open wide and does see.
tr.id: Jangan kau ingkari wahyu yang Baginda Nabi ﷺ terima dalam mimpi beliau. Karena sungguh, ٭ hati beliau tetap terjaga meski kedua mata tertidur.

lines.ar: وَذَاكَ حِينَ بُلُوغٍ مِنْ نُبَوَّتِهِ ٭ فَلَيْسَ يُنْكَرُ فِيهِ حَالُ مُحْتَلِمِ
lines.translit: Wa dhāka ḥīna bulūghin min nubuwwatihi ٭ Fa laysa yunkaru fīhi ḥālu muḥtalimi

tr.en: That was when he attained his Prophetic status; ٭ the night dreams of mature men cannot be denied!
tr.enSingable: And that was so at the very start of his prophethood: ٭ So with that state of the dreaming no one can disagree.
tr.id: Hal itu terjadi semenjak beliau ﷺ diangkat menjadi nabi. ٭ Maka sejak saat itu, tak seorang pun boleh mengingkari mimpi Baginda Nabi ﷺ.

lines.ar: تَبَارَكَ اللهُ مَا وَحَيٌ بِمُكْتَسَبٍ ٭ وَلاَ نَبيُّ عَلَى غَيْبٍ بِمُتَّهَمِ
lines.translit: Tabārak Allahu mā waḥyun bi muktasabin ٭ Wa lā nabiyyun ʿalā ghaybin bi muttahami

tr.en: Blessed is Allah! Revelation is not something acquired! ٭ Nor can a Prophet’s knowledge of the Unseen be deemed suspect.
tr.enSingable: How blest is God: revelation isn't something attained; ٭ Nor is a prophet suspected in what we do not see.
tr.id: Mahasuci Allah. Wahyu bukan termasuk perkara yang dapat dicari/diusahakan ٭ dan tidaklah seorang nabi pantas dicurigai dalam berita gaibnya.

lines.ar: كَمْ أَبْرَأَتْ وَصِبًا بِاللَّمْسِ رَاحَتُهُ ٭ وَأَطْلَقَتْ أَرِبًا مِنْ رِبْقَةِ اللَّمَمِ
lines.translit: Kam abraʾat waṣiban bil lamsi rāḥatuhu ٭ Wa aṭlaqat ariban min ribqatil lamami

tr.en: How many sick people were healed by the touch of his hand; ٭ how many released from the tight knots of madness!
tr.enSingable: How many times has his palm by touch relieved the unwell, ٭ And freed the helpless from in the noose of insanity.
tr.id: Betapa banyak orang sakit yang sembuh seketika sebab disentuh telapak tangan mulia Baginda Nabi ﷺ. ٭ Dengan berkah tangan agung beliau, orang-orang tertu-naikan hajatnya dan sembuh dari sakit gila yang lama membelenggu.

lines.ar: وَأَحْيَتِ السَّنَةَ الشَّهْبَاءَ دَعْوَتُهُ ٭ حَتَّى حَكَتْ غُرَّةً فِي الأَعْصُرِ الدُّهُمِ
lines.translit: Wa aḥyatis sanatash shahbāʾa daʿwatuhu ٭ Ḥattā ḥakat ghurratan fīl aʿṣurid duhumi

tr.en: His supplication brought life to a grey year [of drought] – ٭ Marked it out from dark years like [a horse’s] white blaze.
tr.enSingable: His call gave life to a gray and barren year full of drought; ٭ Till it became like a star in ages of ebony;
tr.id: Doa Baginda Nabi ﷺ telah menghidupkan kembali tahun kekeringan ٭ hingga tahun tersebut bagaikan titik putih di antara hitam nan kelam tahun-tahun lainnya;

lines.ar: بِعَارضٍ جَادَ أَوْ خِلْتَ البِطَاحَ بِهَا ٭ سَيْبًا مِنَ اليَمِّ أَوْ سَيْلاً مِنَ العَرِمِ
lines.translit: Bi ʿāriḍin jāda aw khiltal biṭāḥa bihā ٭ Sayban minal yammi aw saylan minal ʿarimi

tr.en: With generous rainclouds, so much that you would have thought ٭ That the valleys flowed with sea water or the flood of ʿArim.
tr.enSingable: With teeming clouds-you'd have thought the valleys had rivers flow ٭ In from the sea, or a flooded dam that gushed viciously.
tr.id: Dengan awan yang mendermakan hujan deras  hingga kau sangka air yang memenuhi lembah nan luas itu ٭ adalah air aliran dari samudra atau air bah dari bendungan yang pecah.

lines.ar: الفصل ٦

tr.fr: 6. Sur la noblesse du Saint Coran

lines.ar: دَعْنيِ وَوَصْفِي آيَاتٍ لَهُ ظَهَرَتْ ٭ ظُهُورَ نَارِ القِرَى لَيْلاً عَلَى عَلَمِ
lines.translit: Daʿnī wa waṣfī āyātin lahu ẓaharat ٭ Ẓuhūra nāril qirā laylan ʿalā ʿalami

tr.en: Let me describe to you the signs that were manifested for him, ٭ Visible like the village beacons lit atop hills at night.
tr.enSingable:
Leave me alone to describe his miracles, which are plain  ٭ 
As nightly fire on mountains, lit as a courtesy.
tr.id: Biarkanlah aku mengurai mukjizat-mukjizat Baginda Nabi ﷺ yang tampak jelas ٭ bagaikan api jamuan tamu yang dinyalakan pada malam hari di atas gunung menjulang tinggi.

lines.ar: فَالدُّرُّ يَزْدَادُ حُسْنًا وَهْوَ مُنْتَظِمٌ ٭ وَلَيْسَ يَنْقُصُ قَدْرًا غَيْرَ مُنْتَظِمِ
lines.translit: Fad durru yazdādu ḥusnan wa huwa muntaẓimun ٭ Wa laysa yanquṣu qadran ghayra muntaẓimi

tr.en: Though a pearl is more lovely when strung [with others], ٭ Its value is not diminished when alone and unstrung.
tr.enSingable:
For pearls increase in their beauty when arranged on a string,  ٭ 
But aren’t less precious kept alone and separately
tr.id: Mutiara akan bertambah indah bila terangkai rapi, ٭ meski nilainya tak akan berkurang sedikit pun saat tak tersusun.

lines.ar: فَمَا تَطَاوُلُ آمَالِ المَديحِ إِلَى ٭ مَا فِيهِ مِنْ كَرَمِ الأَخْلاَقِ وَالشِّيَمِ
lines.translit: Famā taṭāwulu āmālil madīḥi ilā ٭ Mā fīhi min karamil akhlāqi wash shiyami

tr.en: To what hope can the giver of praise aspire ٭ Of doing justice to his noble qualities and traits?
tr.enSingable:
What eulogizing has any hope of stretching to reach ٭ 
What he possesses in noble nature and quality?
tr.id: Budi luhur baginda Nabi ﷺ sangat banyak sekali. Maka mustahil terlaksana harapan para pengagum ٭ untuk menguraikan seluruh budi pekerti, watak, dan kepribadian beliau.

lines.ar: آيَاتُ حَقٍّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَانِ مُحْدَثَةٌ ٭ قَدِيمَةٌ صِفَةُ المَوْصُوفِ بِالقِدَمِ
lines.translit: Āyātu ḥaqqin minar raḥmāni muḥdathatun ٭ Qadīmatun ṣifatul mawṣūfi bil qidami

tr.en: Signs of truth from the All-Merciful—revealed within time ٭ Yet pre-eternal; the attribute of Him who is pre-eternal.
tr.enSingable: True signs from the Merciful, originated in time, ٭ Beginningless, trait of Him Who is beginninglessly.
tr.id: Termasuk mukjizat Baginda Nabi ﷺ adalah ayat-ayat al-Qur'an, wahyu dari Tuhan Yang Maha Pengasih. Ayat al-Qur'an baru (hadits) turunnya, ٭ namun terdahulu (qadim) maknanya karena ia merupakan sifat dari Dzat Yang Mahadahulu (Qadim).

lines.ar: لَمْ تَقْتَرِنْ بِزَمِانٍ وَهْيَ تُخْبِرُنَا ٭ عَنْ المَعَادِ وَعَنْ عَادٍ وَعَنْ إِرَمِ
lines.translit: Lam taqtarin bizamānin wa hيya tukhbirunā ٭ ʿAnil maʿādi wa ʿan ʿādin wa ʿan irami

tr.en: They are not connected with time, yet they inform us ٭ About the Resurrection, and about ʿĪd and Iram.
tr.enSingable: They aren't bound by constraints of time, as they tell us of ٭ The day to come, also Aad and Irum-past history.
tr.id: Ayat-ayat al-Qur'an tak terikat dengan waktu. Ia mengabarkan kepada kita ٭ tentang Hari Kebangkitan setelah kita meninggal, kaum 'Ad, dan kota Iram.

lines.ar: دَامَتْ لَدَيْنَا فَفَاقَتْ كُلَّ مُعْجِزَةٍ ٭ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ إِذْ جَاءَتْ وَلَمْ تَدُمِ
lines.translit: Dāmat ladaynā fafāqat kulla muʿjizatin ٭ Minan nabiyyīna idh jāʾat wa lam tadumi

tr.en: They remained with us, thus surpassing every miracle ٭ Of the other Prophets, which came but did not last.
tr.enSingable: They stayed among us, and so transcended all miracles ٭ From all the prophets, as they had come and then ceased to be.
tr.id: Ayat-ayat al-Qur'an kekal hingga zaman kita sekarang. Al-Qur'an mengungguli mukjizat ٭ para nabi sebelumnya karena mukjizat mereka tak abadi.

lines.ar: مُحْكَّمَاتٌ فَمَا تُبْقِيْنَ مِنْ شُبَهٍ ٭ لِذِي شِقَاقٍ وَمَا تَبْغِيْنَ مِنْ حَكَمِ
lines.translit: Muḥkamātun famā tubqīna min shubahin ٭ Lidhī shiqāqin wa mā tabghīna min ḥakami

tr.en: Unequivocal verses leaving no doubt to remain ٭ in dissenters, and requiring no arbiter.
tr.enSingable: So wise and clear, that they leave no room for a single doubt ٭ To an opponent and have no need for a referee.
tr.id: Ayat-ayat al-Qur'an sangat kokoh hingga tak menyisakan sedikit pun keraguan  ٭ bagi yang berselisih faham dan tak perlu mencari hakim kebenaran karena begitu jelas dan nyata dalil-dalil yang ada di dalamnya.

lines.ar: مَا حُورِبَتْ قَطُّ إِلاَّ عَادَ مِنْ حَرَبٍ ٭ أَعْدَى الأَعَادِي إِلَيْهَا مُلْقِيَ السَّلَمِ
lines.translit: Mā ḥūribat qaṭṭu illā ʿāda min ḥarabin ٭ Aʿdal aʿādī ilayhā mulqiyas salami

tr.en: No implacable foe has attacked them ٭ But that he retreated from battle and sued for peace.
tr.enSingable: And never were they attacked except that from battle did ٭ Return to them with surrendered arms the worst enemy.
tr.id: Musuh paling hebat tidak akan menentang ayat al-Qur'an, kecuali mereka kembali dari medan peperangan ٭ dalam keadaan tertunduk pasrah dan sadar akan lemahnya mereka di hadapan al-Qur'an.

lines.ar: رَدَّتْ بَلاَغَتُهَا دَعْوَى مُعَارِضِهَا ٭ رَدَّ الغَيُورِ يَدَ الجَانِي عَنِ الْحُرَمِ
lines.translit: Raddat balāghatuhā daʿwā muʿāriḍihā ٭ Raddal ghayūri yadal jānī ʿanil ḥurami

tr.en: Their sheer eloquence refutes the claim of their opponent, ٭ As a jealous man wards off an assailant’s hand from his wife.
tr.enSingable: Their eloquence fought off their dissenters' claim, as a man ٭ That is protective fights off attack from his family.
tr.id: Keindahan sastra al-Qur'an menolak dan membantah tuduhan para penentang, ٭ sebagaimana penolakan orang yang sangat cemburu saat membela keluarga dari jamahan tangan pendosa.

lines.ar: لَهَا مَعَانٍ كَمَوْجِ البَحْرِ فِي مَدَدٍ ٭ وَفَوْقَ جَوْهَرِهِ فِي الْحُسْنِ وَالقِيَمِ
lines.translit: Lahā maʿānin ka mawjil baḥri fī madadin ٭ Wa fawqa jawharihi fīl ḥusni wal qiyami

tr.en: They contain meanings like the sea’s bountiful waves, ٭ And surpass the sea’s jewels in beauty and value.
tr.enSingable: Possessing meanings like waves upon the sea in support; ٭ Surpassing its treasures in allure and sublimity.
tr.id: Ayat-ayat al-Qur'an mengandung banyak makna laksana ombak lautan. ٭ Keanggunan dan nilainya mengungguli mutiara yang tersimpan dalam samudra.

lines.ar: فَمَا تُعَدُّ وَلاَ تُحْصَى عَجَائِبُهَا ٭ وَلاَ تُسَامُ عَلَى الإِكْثَارِ بِالسَّأَمِ
lines.translit: Famā tuʿaddu wa lā tuḥṣā ʿajāʾibuhā ٭ Wa lā tusāmu ʿalal ikthāri bis saʾami

tr.en: Their marvels can neither be counted nor numbered, ٭ And frequent repetition never gives rise to tedium.
tr.enSingable: Such that their wonders are countless and beyond any bound, ٭ And never found to be tiresome in great quantity.
tr.id: Keajaiban ayat suci al-Qur'an tak terhitung dengan angka. ٭ Akan tetapi, meskipun banyak kandungannya, ayat-ayat al-Qur'an tak menjadikan kita bosan.

lines.ar: قَرَّتْ بِهَا عَيْنُ قَارِيْهَا فَقُلْتُ لَهُ ٭ لَقَدْ ظَفِرْتَ بِحَبْلِ اللهِ فَاعْتَصِمِ
lines.translit: Qarrat bihā ʿaynu qārīhā fa qultu lahu ٭ Laqad ẓafirta bi ḥabliLlāhi faʿtaṣimi

tr.en: They delighted the one who recited them, so I told him, ٭ ‘You have the Rope of Allah, so hold fast to it!’
tr.enSingable: By them is soothed their reciter's eye, so I said to him, ٭ "You have indeed found the rope of God, so hold steadily."
tr.id: Ayat-ayat al-Qur'an sungguh menyejukkan mata pembacanya. Maka aku berkata kepada pembaca al-Qur'an, ٭ "Sungguh, kau telah meraih pegangan tali Allah. Jagalah dan tetaplah berpegang teguh dengan tali tersebut".

lines.ar: إِنْ تَتْلُهَا خِيفَةً مِنْ حَرَّ نَارِ لَظَى ٭ أَطْفَأْتَ حَرِّ لَظَىَ مِنْ وِرْدِهَا الشَّبِمِ
lines.translit: In tatluhā khīfatan min ḥarri nāri laẓā ٭ Aṭfaʾta ḥarra laẓā min wirdihash shabimi

tr.en: If you recite them out of fear of a blazing fire’s heat ٭ from their cool wells they will quench the blazing heat
tr.enSingable: If you recite them in worry of the fire of Hell, ٭ From their cool fountain you douse the burn of Hell utterly.
tr.id: Jika kau melantunkan ayat al-Qur'an karena takut panasnya api Jahannam, ٭ kau akan dapat memadamkan panas Jahannam itu dengan kesejukan bacaan al-Qur'an.

lines.ar: كَأَنَّهَا الحَوْضُ تَبْيَضُّ الوُجُوهُ بِهِ ٭ مِنَ العُصَاةِ وَقَدْ جَاءُوهُ كَالحُمَمِ
lines.translit: Ka annahal ḥawḍu tabyaḍḍul wujūhu bihi ٭ Minal ʿuṣāti wa qad jāʾūhu kal ḥumami

tr.en: Like the Pool, they brighten the faces of the sinful, ٭ Though they had come to it as black as charcoal.
tr.enSingable: Just like the Basin, as it is whitening every face, ٭ Of sinners coming to it like coals as black as can be.
tr.id: Al-Qur'an bagaikan Telaga Kautsar, dapat menerangi wajah ٭ ahli maksiat menjadi putih yang sebelumnya hitam legam bak arang bakar.

lines.ar: وَكَالصِّرَاطِ وَكَالمِيزَانِ مَعْدِلَةً ٭ فَالقِسْطُ مِنْ غَيْرِهَا فِي النَّاسِ لَمْ يَقُمِ
lines.translit: Wa kaṣṣirāṭi wa kalmīzāni maʿdalatan ٭ Falqisṭu min ghayrihā fin nāsi lam yaqumi

tr.en: Like the Traverse and like Scales in justice; ٭ True justice amongst men cannot be upheld from any other source.
tr.enSingable: And like the straight Bridge and like the Balance in equity: ٭ Without them no justice is maintained in society.
tr.id: Al-Qur'an tegak lurus bagai jalan, juga adil abadi bak timbangan (tidak berat sebelah). ٭ Keadilan hukum selain al-Qur'an bagi manusia tiada yang kekal abadi.

lines.ar: لاَ تَعْجَبَنْ لِحَسُودٍ رَاحَ يُنْكِرُهَا ٭ تَجَاهُلاً وَهْوَ عَيْنُ الحَاذِقِ الفَهِمِ
lines.translit: Lā taʿjaban liḥasūdin rāḥa yunkiruhā ٭ Tajāhulan wa huwa ʿaynul ḥādhiqil fahimi

tr.en: Do not be amazed at an envious person who denies them ٭ Feigning ignorance, though he has perception and understanding.
tr.enSingable: Be not amazed by a hater in denial of them, ٭ Who acts unknowing despite full knowledge and mastery.
tr.id: Jangan heran terhadap orang hasud yang selalu mengingkari al-Qur'an. ٭ Ia pura-pura bodoh, padahal cerdas dalam memahaminya.

lines.ar: قَدْ تُنْكِرُ الْعَيْنُ ضَوْءَ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ رَمَدٍ ٭ وَيُنْكِرُ الفَمُ طَعْمَ المَاءِ مِنْ سَقَمِ
lines.translit: Qad tunkirul ʿaynu ḍawʾash shamsi min ramadin ٭ Wa yunkirul famu ṭaʿmal māʾi min saqami

tr.en: For the eye, when inflamed, may be averse to the sun’s light; ٭ And the mouth, when ailing, may loathe water’s taste.
tr.enSingable: An eye may even reject the light of sun when inflamed; ٭ A mouth rejecting the taste of water from malady.
tr.id: Terkadang, mata mengingkari cahaya matahari sebab sakit. ٭ Juga terkadang, lidah mengingkari segarnya air karena sakit yang diderita.

lines.ar: الفصل ٧

tr.fr: 7. Le voyage nocturne et l'ascension (Isrāʾ wa Miʿrāj)

lines.ar: يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ يَمَّمَ العّافُونَ سَاحَتَهُ ٭ سَعْيًا وَفَوْقَ مُتُونِ الأَيْنُقِ الرُّسُمِ
lines.translit: Yā Khayra man yammamal ʿāfūna sāḥatahu ٭ Saʿyan wa fawqa mutūnil aynuqir rusumi

tr.en: O best of those to whose courtyard seekers turn to ٭ Hastening on foot or the backs of strong camels!
tr.enSingable: O best of those whose front yard is sought by those seeking good, ٭ On foot and on backs of camels treading vigorously!
tr.id: Wahai, manusia terbaik yang rumahnya senantiasa dituju para pencari kebaikan! ٭ Mereka datang berbondong-bondong, baik dengan berjalan kaki maupun menunggangi unta yang kokoh berlari.

lines.ar: وَمَنْ هُوَ الآيَةُ الكُبْرَى لِمُعْتَبِرٍ ٭ وَمَنْ هُوَ النِّعْمَةُ العُظْمَى لِمُغْتَنِمِ
lines.translit: Wa man huwal āyatul kubrā limuʿtabirin ٭ Wa man huwan niʿmatul ʿuẓmā limughtanimi

tr.en: O Greatest Sign for those who contemplate! ٭ O Supreme Grace for those who seek to gain!
tr.enSingable: And you who are sign supreme for one who does seek to know! ٭ And greatest blessing for one in search of prosperity!
tr.id: Duhai, rasul yang menjadi pertanda paling agung bagi pencari i'tibar kebenaran! ٭ Duhai, nabi yang menjadi anugerah terbesar bagi orang yang ingin beruntung dengan hidayah Islam!

lines.ar: سَرَيْتَ مِنْ حَرَمٍ لَيْلاً إِلَى حَرَمٍ ٭ كَمَا سَرَى البَدْرُ فِي دَاجٍ مِنَ الظُّلَمِ
lines.translit: Sarayta min ḥaramin laylan ilā ḥaramin ٭ Kamā saral badru fī dājin minaẓ ẓulami

tr.en: You journeyed by night, from Sanctuary to Sanctuary ٭ as the full moon travels through the pitch black sky.
tr.enSingable: From sanctum to sanctum you had made the trip overnight; ٭ Just as the moon makes the trip through darkness nocturnally.
tr.id: Engkau berjalan di tengah gelapnya malam dari Masjidil Haram Makkah menuju Masjidil Aqsha Palestina, ٭ laksana bulan purnama berjalan dalam gulita malam.

lines.ar: وَبِتَّ تَرْقَى إِلَى أَنْ نِلْتَ مَنْزِلَةً ٭ مِنْ قَابِ قَوْسَيْنِ لَمْ تُدْرَكْ وَلَمْ تُرَمِ
lines.translit: Wa bitta tarqā ilā an nilta manzilatan ٭ Min qābi qawsayni lam tudrak wa lam turami

tr.en: That night you ascended till you reached a station ٭ Of Two Bows’ Length—one never attained or hoped for!
tr.enSingable: You spent the night rising up until you had reached a place ٭ A length of two bows, not gained or sought in all history.
tr.id: Engkau terus naik hingga sampai suatu tempat dekat dengan Hadhrah Muqaddasah ٭ sekadar jarak tali busur dengan panahnya, yang belum pernah digapai dan diasa oleh siapa pun sebelumnya.

lines.ar: وَقَدَّمَتْكَ جَمِيعُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ بِهَا ٭ وَالرُّسْلِ تَقْدِيمَ مَخْدُومٍ عَلَى خَدَمِ
lines.translit: Wa qaddamatka jamīʿul anbiyāʾi bihā ٭ War rusli taqdīma makhdūmin ʿalā khadami

tr.en: There all the Prophets and Emissaries gave you precedence, ٭ As a master is given precedence by those who serve him.
tr.enSingable: And all the prophets and messengers had put you ahead, ٭ Just as the served over servants has the priority.
tr.id: Seluruh nabi dan rasul menghormati dan mengutamakan derajatmu, ٭ sebagaimana penghormatan seorang pelayan terhadap majikannya.

lines.ar: وَأَنْتَ تَخْتَرِقُ السَّبْعَ الطِّبَاقَ بِهِمْ ٭ فِي مَوْكِبٍ كُنْتَ فِيهِ الصَّاحِبَ العَلَمِ
lines.translit: Wa anta takhtariqus sabʿaṭ ṭibāqa bihim ٭ Fī mawkibin kunta fīhi ṣāhibal ʿalami

tr.en: You traversed the seven heavens with them [behind you] ٭ In a procession wherein you were the standard-bearer.
tr.enSingable: As you proceeded through all the seven levels with them, ٭ In a procession, you were the banner bearer to see;
tr.id: Bersama mereka, engkau menembus tujuh lapis langit. ٭ Dalam rombongan itu, engkaulah sang pemegang bendera.

lines.ar: حَتَّى إِذَا لَمْ تَدَعْ شَأْوًا لِمُسْتَبِقٍ ٭ مِنَ الدُّنُوِّ وَلاَ مَرْقَى لِمُسْتَنِمِ
lines.translit: Ḥattā idhā lam tadaʿ shaʾwan limustabiqin ٭ Minad dunuwwi wa lā marqan li mustanimi

tr.en: Until your proximity left no space for the avid seeker, ٭ Nor any higher summit for one seeking elevation.
tr.enSingable: Until you had left no goal for the ambitious in hope ٭ Of closeness, nor height for someone seeking ascendency.
tr.id: Hingga engkau tak meninggalkan satu puncak pun bagi orang yang ingin mendahuluimu ٭ dan tidak pula engkau meninggalkan tangga untuk orang yang mencari kedudukan tinggi di sisi Allah.

lines.ar: خَفَضْتَ كُلَّ مَقَامٍ بِالإِضَافَةٍ إِذْ ٭ نُودِيْتَ بِالرَّفْعِ مِثْلَ المُفْرَدِ العَلَمِ
lines.translit: Khafaḍta kulla maqāmin bil iḍāfati idh ٭ Nūdīta bir rafʿi mithlal mufradil ʿalami

tr.en: You surpassed all other stations in comparison ٭ When acclaimed on high as ‘The Matchless and Eminent’–
tr.enSingable: You humbled all ranks by annexation: you were addressed, ٭ Like unannexed proper noun, with singular dignity.
tr.id: Derajat siapa pun menjadi rendah dibandingkan dengan tingginya derajatmu saat ٭ Allah memanggilmu secara khusus daripada nabi lainnya, bagaikan mufrod 'alam dalam kekhususannya.

lines.ar: كَيْمَا تَفُوزَ بِوَصْلٍ أَيِّ مُسْتَتِرٍ ٭ عَنْ العُيُونِ وَسِرٍّ أَيِّ مُكْتَتَمِ
lines.translit: Kaymā tafūza biwaṣlin ayyi mustatirin ٭ ʿAnil ʿuyūni wa sirrin ayyi muktatami

tr.en: So that you might triumph through a tryst hidden ٭ From sight. How hidden a secret that was!
tr.enSingable: So that you triumph with a connection oh so concealed ٭ From eyes, and a secret oh so shrouded in mystery!
tr.id: Supaya engkau meraih hubungan khusus dengan Allah yang tersembunyi ٭ dari pandangan mata dan peroleh rahasia besar yang tersimpan rapat dari makhluk lain.

lines.ar: فَحُزْتَ كُلَّ فَخَارٍ غَيْرَ مُشْتَرَكٍ ٭ وَجُزْتَ كُلَّ مَقَامٍ غَيْرَ مُزْدَحَمِ
lines.translit: Fa ḥuzta kulla fakhārin ghayra mushtarakin ٭ Wa juzta kulla maqāmin ghayra muzdaḥami

tr.en: So you received every glory without rival ٭ And gained every station alone, unbeset.
tr.enSingable: So you obtained every glory, no one else joining you; ٭ And you surpassed all alone, unchallenged, every degree.
tr.id: Maka engkau pun peroleh kebanggaan yang tak diraih orang lain ٭ dan engkau lampaui setiap kedudukan mulia tanpa ada pesaing.

lines.ar: وَجَلَّ مِقْدَارُ مَا وُلِّيتَ مِنْ رُتَبٍ ٭ وَعَزَّ إِدْرَاكُ مَا أُولِيْتَ مِنْ نِعَمِ
lines.translit: Wa jalla miqdāru wā wullīta min rutabin ٭ Wa ʿazza idrāku mā ūlīta min niʿami

tr.en: How glorious is the worth of the ranks you were given ٭ How difficult it is to grasp the graces conferred!
tr.enSingable: The measure of stations you were granted, what majesty! ٭ Attaining the blessings you were given, what rarity!
tr.id: Sungguh, betapa agung derajat yang engkau sandang ٭ dan betapa langka nikmat yang telah Allah anugerahkan kepadamu.

lines.ar: بُشْرَى لَنَا مَعْشَرَ الإِسْلَامِ إِنَّ لَنَا ٭ مِنَ العِنَايَةِ رُكْنًا غَيْرَ مُنْهَدِمِ
lines.translit: Bushrā lanā maʿsharal islāmi inna lanā ٭ Minal ʿināyati ruknan ghayra munhadimi

tr.en: Glad tidings for us, O people of Islam, ٭ For we have an indestructible pillar of divine care.
tr.enSingable: Great news for us, people of Islam! Indeed, we possess ٭ A pillar of special care erected unbreakably.
tr.id: Kabar gembira bagi kita umat Islam. Dengan pertolongan Allah, kita mempunyai ٭ pilar kokoh yang takkan pernah hancur, yaitu agama Islam.

lines.ar: لَمَّا دَعَا اللهُ دَاعِينَا لِطَاعَتِهِ ٭ بِأَكْرَمِ الرُّسْلِ كُنَّا أَكْرَمَ الأُمَمِ
lines.translit: Lammā daʿāLlāhu dāʿīnā liṭāʿatihi ٭ Bi akramir rusli kunna akramal umami

tr.en: When Allah named the one who called us to obey Him ٭ The Noblest of Emissaries, we became the noblest of nations!
tr.enSingable: And since Allah called the one who called us to serving Him ٭ The Greatest Prophet, we are the greatest community.
tr.id: Tatkala Allah memanggil Baginda Nabi ﷺ sang pengajak ketaatan dengan sebutan ٭ 'Rasul yang Paling Mulia', maka jadilah kita sebagai umat termulia di antara umat-umat sebelumnya.

lines.ar: الفصل ٨

tr.fr: 8. Sur le jihad et les exploits du Prophète ﷺ

lines.ar: رَاعَتْ قُلُوبَ الْعِدَا أَنْبَاءُ بِعْثَتِهِ ٭ كَنَبْأَةٍ أَجْفَلَتْ غُفْلاً مِنَ الْغَنَمِ
lines.translit: Rāʿat qulūbal ʿidā anbāʾu biʿthatihi ٭ Kanabʾatin ajfalat ghuflan minal ghanami

tr.en: The news of his being sent had cast fear into the hearts of foes ٭ as heedless sheep are startled by sudden noise.
tr.enSingable: The news of his being sent alarmed the hearts of the foes, ٭ Just like a roar causing heedless sheep to startle and flee.
tr.id: Hati musuh gentar ketakutan dengan berita kenabian Baginda Nabi ﷺ ٭ laksana kambing yang tersesat dari golongannya gentar takut saat mendengar auman harimau.

lines.ar: مَا زَالَ يَلْقَاهُمُ فِي كُلِّ مُعْتَرَكٍ ٭ حَتَّى حَكَوْا بِالْقَنَا لَحْمًا عَلَى وَضَمِ
lines.translit: Mā zāla yalqāhumu fī kulli muʿtarakin ٭ Ḥattā ḥakaw bil qanā laḥman ʿalā waḍami

tr.en: He continued to meet them on every battleground ٭ Until spears cut them, like meat on a butcher’s block.
tr.enSingable: He kept courageously facing them at each battlefield, ٭ Till they were butchered by spears like meat in a butchery.
tr.id: Baginda Nabi ﷺ tak ada hentinya berhadapan melawan orang kafir dalam setiap medan peperangan ٭ hingga daging mereka berserakan siap disantap burung dan binatang buas.

lines.ar: وَدُّوا الفِرَارَ فَكَادُوا يَغْبِطُونَ بِهِ ٭ أَشْلاَءَ شَالَتْ مَعَ الْعِقْبَانِ وَالرَّخَمِ
lines.translit: Waddul firāra fakādū yaghbiṭūna bihi ٭ Ashlāʾa shālat maʿal ʿiqbāni war rakhami

tr.en: They longed to flee, almost jealous of ٭ The dead flesh carried off by hawks and vultures.
tr.enSingable: They longed to flee so much that they watched the parts carried off ٭ By buzzards and vultures in a state of near jealousy.
tr.id: Para musuh ingin lari dari medan perang. Bahkan karena putus asa, hampir saja mereka berharap ٭ segera mati lalu tubuhnya dibawa terbang burung elang dan rajawali.

lines.ar: تَمْضِي اللَّيَالِي وَلاَ يَدْرُونَ عِدَّتَهَا ٭ مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ مِنْ لَيَالِي الأَشْهُرِ الْحُرُمِ
lines.translit: Tamḍil layālī wa lā yadrūna ʿiddatahā ٭ Mā lam takun min layālil ash-huril ḥurumi

tr.en: The nights passed with them unaware of their number, ٭ Apart from the nights of the Sacred Months.
tr.enSingable: The nights would pass with them unaware the number of them, ٭ Except the nights of the Sacred Months of tranquility.
tr.id: Berlalu siang dan malam sedang mereka tak tahu berapa hitungan hari yang telah mereka lalui dalam peperangan. ٭ Mereka tidak tahu hitungan hari selagi bukan dalam bulan-bulan mulia.

lines.ar: كَأَنَّمَا الدِّينُ ضَيْفٌ حَلَّ سَاحَتَهُمْ ٭ بِكُلِّ قَرْمٍ إِلَى لَحْمِ العِدَا قَرِمِ
lines.translit: Ka annamad dīnu ḍayfun ḥalla sāḥatahum ٭ Bi kulli qarmin ilā laḥmil ʿidā qarimi

tr.en: As if the religion were a guest that had arrived at their courtyard, ٭ With every honoured chieftain eager for the flesh of their foes.
tr.enSingable: As if religion had been a guest arrived at their yard, ٭ With every nobleman craving meat of the enemy.
tr.id: Islam laksana seorang tamu undangan yang singgah di halaman sahabat Nabi, ٭ para pemberani yang sangat lapar ingin membunuh musuh Islam.

lines.ar: يَجُرُّ بَحْرَ خَمِيسٍ فَوْقَ سَابِحَةٍ ٭ يَرْمِى بِمَوْجٍ مِنَ الأَبْطَالِ مُلْتَطِمِ
lines.translit: Yajurru baḥra khamīsin fawqa sābiḥatin ٭ Yarmī bi mawjin minal abṭāli multaṭimi

tr.en: Bringing forth a sea of soldiers on swift steeds, ٭ Tossing wave upon wave of onrushing heroes.
tr.enSingable: It brought an ocean of troops on gracefully-floating steeds, ٭ Advancing waves made of heroes, surging successively.
tr.id: Islam bagai tamu yang menggerakkan lautan pasukan penunggang kuda nan berenang jaya. ٭ Ia membawa kesatria pemberani bak debur ombak samudra karena banyaknya.

lines.ar: مِنْ كُلِّ مُنْتَدَبٍ لِلهِ مُحْتَسِبٍ ٭ يَسْطُو بِمُسْتَأْصِلٍ لِلكُفْرِ مُصْطَلِمِ
lines.translit: Min kulli muntadibin liLlāhi muḥtasibin ٭ Yasṭū bimustaʾṣilin lil kufri muṣṭalimi

tr.en: All responding to Allah’s call and anticipating reward, ٭ Boldly charging on, and uprooting disbelief.
tr.enSingable: Each in response to the call of God, in hope of reward, ٭ Attacking armed to uproot and shatter idolatry.
tr.id: Pasukan terdiri dari setiap orang yang menyambut panggilan Allah serta mengharapkan pahala dari-Nya. ٭ Mereka menyerang dengan pedang untuk membasmi kekufuran hingga akarnya.

lines.ar: حَتىَّ غَدَتْ مِلَّةُ الإِسْلاَمِ وَهْيَ بِهِمْ ٭ مِنْ بَعْدِ غُرْبَتِهَا مَوْصُولَةَ الرَّحِمِ
lines.translit: Ḥatta ghadat millatul islāmi wahya bihim ٭ Min baʿdi ghurbatihā mawṣūlatar rahimi

tr.en: Until the religion of Islam was, through them, ٭ Reunited in kinship after being in exile.
tr.enSingable: Until the Faith of Islam, with them among it, became- ٭ Once having been foreign-now a unified family.
tr.id: Berkat kegigihan para sahabat, agama Islam yang dahulu asing bagi pemeluknya ٭ kini menjadi penghubung persaudaraan di antara mereka.

lines.ar: مَكْفُولَةً أَبَدًا مِنْهُمْ بِخَيْرِ أَبٍ ٭ وَخَيْرِ بَعْلٍ فَلَمْ تَيْتَمْ وَلَمْ تَئِمِ
lines.translit: Makfūlatan abadan minhum bi khayri abin ٭ Wa khayri baʿlin fa lam taytam wa lam taʾimi

tr.en: Forever protected from [foes] by the best of fathers and husbands, ٭ So that she was no longer an orphan or a widow.
tr.enSingable: Protected forever from them by the best father and ٭ Best husband, so not an orphan or a widow is she.
tr.id: Agama Islam terjaga dan terjamin selamanya oleh sebaik-baik ayah ٭ dan sebaik-baik suami. Maka Islam pun takkan pernah menjadi yatim dan janda.

lines.ar: هُمُ الجِبَالُ فَسَلْ عَنْهُمْ مُصَادِمَهُمْ ٭ مَاذَا رَأَى مِنْهُمُ فِي كُلِّ مُصْطَدَمِ
lines.translit: Humul jibālu fasal ʿanhum muṣādimahum ٭ Mādhā raʾā minhumu fī kulli muṣṭadami

tr.en: They were mountains! Ask those who came to blows with them ٭ What they saw from them on every field of battle.
tr.enSingable: They are the mountains, so ask about them their battle-foe, ٭ At every battle, the things from them that he used to see.
tr.id: Mereka kesatria laksana gunung yang kokoh. Bertanyalah pada musuh ٭ apa yang ia lihat pada setiap medan pertempuran.

lines.ar: وَسَلْ حُنَيْنًا وَسَلْ بَدْرًا وَسَلْ أُحُدًا ٭ فُصُولَ حَتْفٍ لَهُمْ أَدْهَى مِنَ الوَخَمِ
lines.translit: Wa sal ḥunaynan wa sal badran wa sal uḥudan ٭ Fuṣūla ḥatfin lahum adʾhā minal wakhami

tr.en: Ask Ḥunayn, ask Badr, ask Uḥud— ٭ Seasons of death, more disastrous for them than the plague!
tr.enSingable: And ask Hunayn, question Badr, and even ask Uhud, too- ٭ Events of death for them, worse than plague in catastrophe.
tr.id: Dan tanyakanlah tentang hebatnya mereka kepada kejadian perang Hunain, Badar, serta Uhud. ٭ Maka ketiga kejadian tersebut akan menjawab bahwa semua itu adalah tempat malapetaka yang lebih ganas dari wabah menular.

lines.ar: المُصْدِرِي البِيضِ حُمْرًا بَعْدَ مَا وَرَدَتْ ٭ مِنَ العِدَا كُلَّ مُسْوَدٍّ مِنَ اللِّمَمِ
lines.translit: Almuṣdiril bīḍi ḥumran baʿda mā waradat ٭ Minal ʿidā kulla muswaddin minal limami

tr.en: White swords returned, dripping red after taking drink ٭ From beneath the black heads of all their enemies.
tr.enSingable: Returning white blades now turned to crimson after they reached ٭ The fighters with flowing hair of black from the enemy.
tr.id: Pedang para sahabat yang putih berkilau berubah menjadi merah padam ٭ setelah banyak melibas leher musuh yang muda nan kuat.

lines.ar: وَالكَاتِبِينَ بِسُمْرِ الخَطِّ مَا تَرَكَتْ ٭ أَقْلاَمُهُمْ حَرْفَ جِسْمٍ غَيْرَ مُنَعَجِمِ
lines.translit: Wal kātibīna bi sumril khaṭṭi mā tarakat ٭ Aqlāmuhum ḥarfa jismin ghayra munʿajimi

tr.en: Like scribes with wielded spears for pens, ٭ Leaving no letter of a body unmarked with dots.
tr.enSingable: Inscribing with spears of Lettering, their pens didn't leave ٭ A body line with undotted i, and crossed every t.
tr.id: Mereka menulis pada badan para musuh Islam dengan tusukan tombak pena kayu Khat. ٭ Tombak pena tak sisakan satu musuh pun terlepas dari tusukan di badannya.

lines.ar: شَاكِي السِّلاَحِ لَهُمْ سِيمَا تُمَيِّزُهُمْ ٭ وَالوَرْدُ يَمْتَازُ بِالسِّيمَا عَنِ السَّلَمِ
lines.translit: Shākis silāḥi lahum sīmā tumayyizuhum ٭ Wal wardu yamtāzu bis sīmā ʿanis salami

tr.en: Well-armed, they were distinguished by a clear sign, ٭ as a rose differs from an acacia tree in its features.
tr.enSingable: With sharpened weapons they had a mark to set them apart; ٭ A rose is set by its mark apart from a thorny tree.
tr.id: Saat menggunakan senjata, para kesatria memiliki ciri pembeda, ٭ sebagaimana bunga mawar memiliki ciri yang membedakannya dengan pohon salam.

lines.ar: تُهْدِي إِلَيْكَ رِيَاحُ النَّصْرِ نَشْرَهُمُ ٭ فَتَحْسَبُ الزَّهْرَ فِي الأَكْمَامِ كُلَّ كَمِي
lines.translit: Tuhdī ilayka riyāḥun naṣri nashrahumu ٭ Fataḥsabuz zahra fīl akmāmi kulla kamī

tr.en: The winds of victory bring you their scent as a gift; ٭ You would think each armed hero a flower in bud!
tr.enSingable: The victory winds convey to you the sweet news of them; ٭ So flowers in bloom you'd reckon every soldier to be.
tr.id: Angin kemenangan mengirimkan kepadamu harumnya kabar gembira bala tentara ٭ hingga engkau menyangka bunga yang tersimpan di balik kelopak adalah prajurit yang berlindung di balik perisai.

lines.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ فِي ظُهُورِ الخَيْلِ نَبْتُ رُبًا ٭ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الحَزْمِ لاَ مِنْ شِدَّةِ الحُزُمِ
lines.translit: Ka annahum fī ẓuhūril khayli nabtu ruban ٭ Min shiddatil ḥazmi lā min shiddatil ḥuzumi
