tr.en: As if, riding their steeds, they were flowers on a hill-top ٭ Held firm not by strong stirrups, but by strength of resolve.
tr.enSingable: They were in horseback like firmly-rooted plants up on hills- ٭ From grit so solid, not girth of saddle held solidly.
tr.id: Tatkala menunggang kuda, mereka laksana pepohonan di atas bukit nan tinggi. ٭ Mereka sangat kokoh karena kuatnya kemantapan, bukan karena ikatan tali pelana.

lines.ar: طَارَتْ قُلُوبُ العِدَا مِنْ بَأْسِهِمْ فَرَقًا ٭ فَمَا تُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ البَهْمِ وَالبُهُمِ
lines.translit: Ṭārat qulūbul ʿidā min baʾsihim faraqan ٭ Famā tufarriqu baynal bahmi wal buhami

tr.en: Their forceful onslaught so put their foes’ hearts to flight ٭ that you could not have told a herd from a warrior.
tr.enSingable: The enemies' hearts were fluttering in fear of their force, ٭ Unable to tell a lamb apart from brave cavalry.
tr.id: Hati musuh gentar ketakutan karena ketangkasan para pejuang Islam ٭ hingga tak dapat membedakan antara gerombolan anak domba dan pasukan kesatria pemberani.

lines.ar: وَمَنْ تَكُنْ بِرَسُولِ اللهِ نُصْرَتُهُ ٭ إِنْ تَلْقَهُ الأُسْدُ فِي آجَامِهَا تَجِمِ
lines.translit: Wa man takun birasūliLlāhi nuṣratuhu ٭ In talqahul usdu fī ājāmihā tajimi

tr.en: For the one whose help comes from the Emissary of Allah ٭ Even lions finding him in their dens will be loth to face him.
tr.enSingable: Whoever is aided by the Messenger of Allah, ٭ If lions meet him inside their woods, they bow silently.
tr.id: Orang yang pertolongannya bersumber dari Baginda Nabi ﷺ ٭ apabila bertemu harimau di hutan belantara, niscaya harimau tersebut akan tunduk takluk kepadanya.

lines.ar: وَلَنْ تَرَى مِنْ وَليٍّ غَيْرِ مُنْتَصِرٍ ٭ بِهِ وَلاَ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ غَيْرِ مُنْقَصِمِ
lines.translit: Wa lan tarā min waliyyin ghayri muntaṣirin ٭ Bihi wa lā min ʿaduwwin ghayri munqasimi

tr.en: You will not see one saint who is not victorious through him; ٭ Or a single foe of his who is not dealt mortal blows.
tr.enSingable: You will not see any saint that isn't victorious ٭ Through him, nor any opponent not destroyed utterly.
tr.id: Dengan berkah Baginda Nabi ﷺ, engkau tak akan melihat kekasih Islam, kecuali mendapat kemenangan ٭ dan takkan pula kau melihat musuh, kecuali dalam kekalahan.

lines.ar: أَحَلَّ أُمَّتَهُ فِي حِرْزِ مِلَّتِهِ ٭ كَاللَّيْثِ حَلَّ مَعَ الأَشْبَالِ فِي أَجَمِ
lines.translit: Aḥalla ummatahu fī ḥirzi millatihi ٭ Kal laythi ḥalla maʿal ashbāli fī ajami

tr.en: He gave his nation sanctuary in the stronghold of his faith, ٭ As a lion settles in with its cubs in a thicket.
tr.enSingable: He put his nation to dwell inside the fort of his faith; ٭ Like lion dwelling inside the forest with progeny.
tr.id: Baginda Nabi ﷺ menjaga umat beliau dalam benteng agama yang kuat nan kokoh. ٭ Sebagaimana singa menjaga anak-anaknya dengan menempatkan mereka dalam hutan belantara.

lines.ar: كَمْ جَدَّلَتْ كَلِمَاتُ اللهِ مِنْ جَدَلٍ ٭ فِيهِ وَكَمْ خَصَمَ البُرْهَانُ مِنْ خَصِمِ
lines.translit: Kam jaddalat kalimātuLlāhi min jadilin ٭ Fīhi wa kam khaṣamal burhānu min khaṣimi

tr.en: How often have Allah’s words felled his opponents, ٭ And how often the Qur’an has defeated its enemies!
tr.enSingable: How often the words of God refuted the quarrelsome ٭ About him! How often proof defeated the enemy!
tr.id: Seringkali ayat suci al-Qur'an jatuhkan para penantang dalam berdebat. ٭ Betapa banyak dalil pasti al-Qur'an kalahkan orang-orang yang suka memusuhi.

lines.ar: كَفَاكَ بِالْعِلْمِ فِي الأُمِّيِّ مُعْجِزَةً ٭ فِي الجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَالتَّأْدِيبِ فِي اليُتُمِ
lines.translit: Kafāka bil ʿilmi fīl ummiyyi muʿjizatan ٭ Fīl jāhiliyyati wat taʾdībi fīl yutumi

tr.en: The erudition of an unlettered one is miracle enough ٭ in an Age of Ignorance, as is an orphan’s education.
tr.enSingable: Enlightenment in the one unread is wonder enough, ٭ In Age of Darkness; and good upbringing in orphancy.
tr.id: Cukuplah sebagai mukjizat agungmu ilmu yang kau miliki, padahal engkau ummi ٭ yang hidup dalam masa kebodohan juga terdidik dalam keadaan yatim.

lines.ar: الفصل ٩

tr.fr: 9. Sur la demande de pardon et l'intercession

lines.ar: خَدَمْتُهُ بِمَدِيحٍ أَسْتَقِيلُ بِهِ ٭ ذُنُوبَ عُمْرٍ مَضَى فِي الشِّعْرِ وَالخِدَمِ
lines.translit: Khadamtuhu bi madīḥin astaqīlu bihi ٭ Dhunūba ʿumrin maḍā fish shiʿri wal khidami

tr.en: By this eulogy I have served him, seeking absolution ٭ For the sins of a life spent in poetry and patronage.
tr.enSingable: I've served him with eulogy by which I seek to erase ٭ The sins of life spent in poem and in servility.
tr.id: Aku mengabdikan diri kepada Baginda Nabi ﷺ dengan gubahan syair pujian, yang dengan berkahnya aku mengharap ٭ ampunan Allah atas dosa-dosaku yang lampau dalam bersyair dan melayani pejabat.

lines.ar: إِذْ قَلَّدَانِيَ مَا تُخْشَى عَوَاقِبُهُ ٭ كَأَنَّنِي بِهِمَا هَدْىٌ مِنَ النَّعَمِ
lines.translit: Idh qalladāniya mā tukhshā ʿawāqibuhu ٭ Ka annanī bihimā hadyun minan naʿami

tr.en: For these two have yoked me, with consequences I fear; ٭ as if I were, on their account, a ritual lamb for slaughter.
tr.enSingable: For they have led me to things of horrible aftermath; ٭ Akin to livestock decreed by them for the butchery.
tr.id: Bersyair dan melayani pejabat menjeratku dengan sesuatu yang akibatnya mengkhawatirkan. ٭ Dengan sebab itu, seakan-akan aku adalah hewan sembelihan yang dijerat dengan tali.

lines.ar: أَطَعْتُ غَيَّ الصِّبَا فِي الحَالَتَيْنِ وَمَا ٭ حَصَلْتُ إِلاَّ عَلَى الآثَامِ وَالنَّدَمِ
lines.translit: Aṭaʿtu ghayyaṣ ṣibā fīl ḥālatayni wa mā ٭ Ḥaṣaltu illā ʿalal āthāmi wan nadami

tr.en: In both I obeyed the reckless folly of youth, ٭ And gained nothing except sins and regrets.
tr.enSingable: I have obeyed the deceit of youth in both cases and ٭ Got nothing but sins and then regret, oh, what misery!
tr.id: Kutaati rayuan masa muda dalam bersyair dan mengabdi ke pejabat. ٭ Kini aku tak dapatkan sesuatu kecuali dosa dan penyesalan.

lines.ar: فَيَا خَسَارَةَ نَفْسٍ فِي تِجَارَتِهَا ٭ لَمْ تَشْتَرِ الدِّينَ بِالدُّنْيَا وَلَمْ تَسُمِ
lines.translit: Fayā khasārata nafsin fī tijāratihā ٭ Lam tashtarid dīna bid dunyā wal lam tasumi

tr.en: Alas, what abject loss for a soul in its transaction! ٭ It did not buy the Next World at the price of this – or even try to!
tr.enSingable: Oh, what a loss for my soul, the awful deal that it made! ٭ Not buying faith with this world, not even browsing to see.
tr.id: Betapa ruginya jiwaku dalam perniagaan ini ٭ apabila tidak membeli agama dengan dunia, juga tak pernah menawarnya.

lines.ar: وَمَنْ يَبِعْ آجِلاً مِنْهُ بِعَاجِلِهِ ٭ يَبِنْ لَهُ الْغَبْنُ فِي بَيْعٍ وَفِي سَلَمِ
lines.translit: Wa man yabiʿ ājilan minhu bi ʿājilihi ٭ Yabin lahul ghabnu fī bayʿin wa fī salami

tr.en: Anyone who sells the Hereafter for the ephemeral ٭ Will be cheated in their present and future transactions.
tr.enSingable: Whoever sells off his future for his present will come ٭ To see the loss in his sale and future delivery.
tr.id: Barang siapa menjual pahala akhirat dengan gemerlap dunia, ٭ maka kerugiannya sungguh nyata. Baik dalam jual beli maupun akad salam.

lines.ar: إِنْ آتِ ذَنْبًا فَمَا عَهْدِي بِمُنْتَقِضٍ ٭ مَنَ النَّبِيِّ وَلاَ حَبْلِي بِمُنْصَرِمِ
lines.translit: In āti dhanban famā ʿahdī bimuntaqiḍin ٭ Minan nabiyyi wa lā ḥablī bimunṣarimi

tr.en: I have sinned, yet my pledge to the Prophet is unbroken; ٭ Nor has the rope binding me to him been severed.
tr.enSingable: If I engage in a sin, my covenant isn't void ٭ With him, the Prophet; nor is the rope dissevered from me.
tr.id: Jikalau aku kembali melakukan dosa, janji imanku pada  ٭ Baginda Nabi ﷺ takkan terlepas. Begitu pula tali hubunganku dengan beliau takkan terputus.

lines.ar: فَإِنَّ لِي ذِمَّةً مِنْهُ بِتَسْمِيَتيِ ٭ مُحَمَّداً وَهْوَ أَوْفَى الخَلْقِ بِالذِّمَمِ
lines.translit: Fa inna lī dhimmatan minhu bi tasmiyatī ٭ Muḥammadan wa huwa awfāl khalqi bidh dhimami

tr.en: For I have a protective covenant with him owing to my name— ٭ Muḥammad—and he is the most loyal of mankind to covenants.
tr.enSingable: By naming my son Muhammad I am in pledge to him; ٭ And none is more faithful in fulfilling pledges than he.
tr.id: Sesungguhnya, aku memiliki jaminan dari Baginda Nabi ﷺ dengan namaku ٭ 'Muhammad'. Baginda Nabi ﷺ adalah makhluk paling setia dalam memenuhi janji.

lines.ar: إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي مَعَادِي آخِذًا بِيَدِي ٭ فَضْلاً وَإِلاَّ فَقُلْ يَا زَلَّةَ القَدَمِ
lines.translit: In lam yakun fī maʿādī ākhidhan bi yadī ٭ Faḍlan wa illā faqul yā zallatal qadami

tr.en: If, in the Hereafter, he does not take me by the hand ٭ From pure grace, what a terrible slip of the foot!
tr.enSingable: At my appointment, if he's not holding onto my hand- ٭ In graciousness-say, "Oh, what a fall into tragedy!"
tr.id: Jikalau kelak di akhirat Baginda Nabi ﷺ tak menganugerahiku dengan uluran tangan ٭ pertolongan beliau, sungguh tergelincirlah kakiku dalam api neraka.

lines.ar: حَاشَاهُ أَنْ يَحْرِمَ الرَّاجِي مَكَارِمَهُ ٭ أَوْ يَرْجِعَ الجَارُ مِنْهُ غَيْرَ مُحْتَرَمِ
lines.translit: Ḥāshāhu an yaḥrimar rājī makārimahu ٭ Aw yarjiʿal jāru minhu ghayra muḥtarami

tr.en: Far be it for him to deprive one hopeful of his generous gifts, ٭ Or for a neighbour to turn back without being honoured by him!
tr.enSingable: Far be it from him to bar the aspirant of his gifts, ٭ Or send away in dishonor from him a refugee.
tr.id: Tidak mungkin Baginda Nabi ﷺ menolak memberi anugerah kepada orang yang telah mengharapkan. ٭ Tak mungkin pula tetangga Baginda Nabi ﷺ kembali dari rumah beliau dalam keadaan tak mulia.

lines.ar: وَمُنْذُ أَلْزَمْتُ أَفْكَارِي مَدَائِحَهُ ٭ وَجَدْتُهُ لِخَلاَصِي خَيْرَ مُلْتَزِمِ
lines.translit: Wa mundhu alzamtu afkārī madāʾiḥahu ٭ Wajadtuhu likhalāṣī khayra multazimi

tr.en: Ever since I have focused my thoughts on his praises, ٭ I have found him the one most committed to my salvation.
tr.enSingable: And since committing my thoughts to singing praises of him, ٭ I've found him to be the most committed to saving me.
tr.id: Semenjak kupusatkan segenap fikiranku untuk memuji beliau, ٭ kudapati Baginda Nabi g adalah sebaik-baiknya pemberi jaminan untuk keselamatanku.

lines.ar: وَلَنْ يَفُوتَ الغِنَى مِنْهُ يَدًا تَرِبَتْ ٭ إِنَّ الحَيَا يُنْبِتَ الأَزْهَارَ فِي الأَكَمِ
lines.translit: Wa lan yafūtal ghinā minhu yadan taribat ٭ Innal ḥayā yunbitul azhāra fīl akami

tr.en: His wealth will not overlook a dusty, needy hand; ٭ For showers cause flowers to bloom on hill-tops.
tr.enSingable: The riches from him will not neglect a poor, dusty hand; ٭ Indeed, the rain causes even hills to be flowery.
tr.id: Tangan seorang fakir yang membutuhkan tak akan luput dari pemberian Baginda Nabi ﷺ. ٭ Sungguh, pemberian beliau bagaikan hujan yang akan menumbuhkan bunga-bunga di bukit tinggi.

lines.ar: وَلَمْ أُرِدْ زَهْرَةَ الدُّنْيَا الَّتيِ اقْتَطَفَتْ ٭ يَدَا زُهَيْرٍ بِمَا أَثْنَى عَلَى هَرِمِ
lines.translit: Wa lam urid zahratad dunyal latiqtaṭafat ٭ Yadā zuhayrin bimā athnā ʿalā harimi

tr.en: I sought not the flowers of this world ٭ Which Zuhayr picked for his praise of Harim.
tr.enSingable: I sought no bloom of the lower world the hands of Zuhayr ٭ Had picked for having presented Herim with flattery.
tr.id: Aku memuji Baginda Nabi ﷺ bukan ingin menuai kenikmatan dunia sebagaimana ٭ Zuhair memetik dunia dengan kedua tangannya sebagai imbalan dari puji-pujian kepada raja Harim bin Sinan.

lines.ar: الفصل ١٠
يَا أَكْرَمَ الخَلْقِ مَالَي مَنْ أَلُوذُ بِهِ ٭ سِوَاكَ عِنْدَ حُلُولِ الحَادِثِ العَمِمِ
lines.translit: Yā akramal khalqi mālī man alūdhu bihi ٭ Siwāka ʿinda ḥulūlil ḥādithil ʿamimi

tr.en: O Noblest of Creation, whose protection can I seek ٭ But yours, when the Universal Event comes to pass?
tr.enSingable: Most Noble of All Creation, what refuge do I have ٭ But you at the coming of the global emergency?
tr.id: Wahai, makhluk paling mulia! Selainmu, tiada lagi bagiku  ٭ tempat berlindung kelak tatkala malapetaka hari kiamat menyeluruh.

lines.ar: وَلَنْ يَضِيقَ رَسُولَ اللهِ جَاهُكَ بيِ ٭ إِذَا الكَرِيمُ تَجَلَّى بِاسْمِ مُنْتَقِمِ
lines.translit: Wa lan yaḍīqa rasūlaLlāhi jāhuka bī ٭ Idhal karīmu tajjalā bismi muntaqimi

tr.en: O Emissary of Allah, your rank will not be diminished ٭ By me when the Generous One appears, named as the Avenger.
tr.enSingable: O Messenger of Allah, your rank won't shrink from me when ٭ The Generous manifests His punishing quality.
tr.id: Wahai Rasulallah ﷺ, derajatmu tak akan menjadi sempit karenaku, ٭ di saat Allah Dzat Yang Mulia bersifat dengan nama Muntaqim, yaitu Dzat Yang menjalankan siksaan-Nya.

lines.ar: فَإِنَّ مِنْ جُودِكَ الدُّنْيَا وَضَرَّتَهَا ٭ وَمِنْ عُلُومِكَ عِلْمَ اللَّوْحِ وَالقَلَمِ
lines.translit: Fa inna min jūdikad dunyā wa ḍarratahā ٭ Wa min ʿulūmika ʿilmal lawḥi wal qalami

tr.en: For this world and its companion the Next come from your bounty, ٭ And part of what you know is knowledge of the Tablet and Pen.
tr.enSingable: Yes, from your grace is indeed the world as well as its mate; ٭ And of your knowledge the Tablet and the Pen of decree.
tr.id: Sungguh, di antara kedermawananmu adalah dunia dan akhirat, ٭ dan termasuk pengetahuanmu adalah ilmu yang terdapat pada Lauh Mahfudz & tercatat oleh Qalam (pena).

lines.ar: يَا نَفْسُ لاَ تَقْنَطِي مِنْ زَلَّةٍ عَظُمَتْ ٭ إَنَّ الكَبَائِرَ فِي الغُفْرَانِ كَاللَّمَمِ
lines.translit: Yā nafsu lā taqnaṭī min zallatin ʿaẓumat ٭ Innal kabāʾira fīl ghufrāni kal lamami

tr.en: O soul, despair not over a fault that is immense; ٭ Enormities, with divine forgiveness, are like minor errors.
tr.enSingable: O soul, despair not because of a mistake that is grave; ٭ Enormities are like slips compared to His clemency.
tr.id: Wahai jiwa, janganlah kau berputus asa karena kesalahan yang teramat besar. ٭ Sungguh, dosa-dosa besar jika dibandingkan dengan luasnya ampunan Allah laksana dosa kecil.

lines.ar: لَعَلَّ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّي حِينَ يَقْسِمُهَا ٭ تَأْتِي عَلَى حَسَبِ العِصْيَانِ فِي الْقِسَمِ
lines.translit: Laʿalla raḥmata rabbī ḥīna yaqsimuhā ٭ Taʾtī ʿalā ḥasabil ʿiṣyāni fīl qisami

tr.en: Perchance my Lord’s mercy, when He apportions it, ٭ Will be distributed in accordance with the measure of sins.
tr.enSingable: And hopefully, mercy from my Lord when He gives it out ٭ Will come according to sinfulness in its quantity.
tr.id: Semoga rahmat Allah saat dibagikan ٭ sesuai dengan kadar kemaksiatan hamba-Nya.

lines.ar: يَا رَبِّ وَاجْعَلْ رَجَائِي غَيْرَ مُنْعَكِسٍ ٭ لَدَيْكَ وَاجْعَلْ حِسَابِي غَيْرَ مُنْخَرِمِ
lines.translit: Yā rabbi wajʿal rajāʾī ghayra munʿakisin ٭ Ladayka wajʿal ḥisābī ghayra munkharimi

tr.en: O my Lord, let not my hope in You be overturned ٭ And do not make my account devoid of value.
tr.enSingable: My Lord, and make not my hope a hope that is overturned ٭ With you; and make my expectance with no deficiency.
tr.id: Wahai Tuhanku, jangan jadikan harapanku berbeda ٭ dengan apa yang ada di sisi-Mu dan jangan jadikan keyakinanku pada_Mu berlalu begitu saja tanpa ijabah dari-Mu.

lines.ar: وَالْطُفْ بِعَبْدِكَ فِي الدَّارَيْنِ إَنَّ لَهُ ٭ صَبْرًا مَتَى تَدْعُهُ الأَهْوَالُ يَنْهَزِمِ
lines.translit: Walṭuf biʿabdika fid dārayni inna lahu ٭ Ṣabran matā tadʿuhul ahwālu yanhazimi

tr.en: Be gentle with Your servant in this life and the Next; ٭ For his patience flees when he is visited by terrors.
tr.enSingable: Be kind to Your slave in both abodes; for his fortitude ٭ Whenever terrors call out to it will turn tail and flee.
tr.id: Ya Allah, lemah lembutlah terhadap hamba-Mu ini di dunia serta di akhirat kelak. Sungguh, ٭ kesabarannya sangat lemah. Kapan pun tertimpa musibah, ia akan lari menjauh.

lines.ar: وَأْذَنْ لِسُحْبِ صَلاَةٍ مِنْكَ دَائِمَةٍ ٭ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ بِمُنْهَلٍّ وَمُنْسَجِمِ
lines.translit: Waʾdhan lisuḥbi ṣalātin minka dāʾimatin ٭ ʿAlan nabiyyi bimunhallin wa munsajimi

tr.en: And may clouds of Your blessings rain down constantly ٭ Upon the Prophet, pouring down in abundance.
tr.enSingable: Let clouds of blessing from You, unending, rain down upon ٭ The Prophet, with pouring rain so heavily, steadily.
tr.id: Wahai Tuhanku, semoga Engkau senantiasa mengaruniakan iringan awan selawat-Mu ٭ untuk Nabi Muhammad ﷺ sebagaimana derasnya aliran hujan.

lines.ar: مَا رَنَّحَتْ عَذَبَاتِ الْبَانِ رِيحُ صَبًا ٭ وَأَطْرَبَ الْعِيسَ حَادِي الْعِيسِ بِالنَّغَمِ
lines.translit: Mā rannaḥat ʿadhabātil bāni rīḥu ṣaban ٭ Wa aṭrabal ʿīsa ḥādil ʿīsi bin naghami

tr.en: For as long as the east wind stirs the branches of willows, ٭ And camel-drivers bring joy to their camels with melody.
tr.enSingable: For longer than willow branches by the east wind are swayed; ٭ And camel drivers excite the camels with melody.
tr.id: Curahkanlah selawat-Mu selagi angin masih menggoyang ranting_ranting pohon B__n ٭ dan selama pengembala masih melenggak-lenggokkan unta dengan merdunya lantunan suara.

lines.ar: ثُمَّ الرِّضَا عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعَنْ عُمَرٍ ٭ وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ وَعَنْ عُثْمَانَ ذِي الْكَرَمِ
lines.translit: Thummar riḍā ʿan abī bakrin wa ʿan ʿumarin ٭ Wa ʿan ʿaliyyin wa ʿan ʿuthmāna dhil karami

tr.en: Then extend Your good-pleasure to Abū Bakr and to ʿUmar ٭ And to ‘Ali, and to ʿUthmān, the generous
tr.enSingable: Then pleasure with Abu Bakr, the greatest of company, ٭ And Umar, bearer of Truth, and then Uthman, and Ali,
tr.id: Semoga Engkau meridai para sahabat mulia Nabi ﷺ: Abu Bakar ash-Shiddiq, 'Umar bin al-Khatthab, ٭ 'Utsman bin 'Affan, dan Ali bin Abi Thalib.

lines.ar: وَالآلِ وَالصَّحْبِ ثُمَّ التَابِعِيَن فَهُمْ ٭ أَهْلُ التُّقَى وَالنَّقَا وَالحِلْمِ وَالْكَرَمِ
lines.translit: Wal āli waṣ ṣaḥbi thummat tābiʿīna fahum ٭ Ahlut tuqā wan naqā wal ḥilmi wal karami

tr.en: And to the Family and the Companions, and then the Followers—the people of Godfearingness, ٭ purity, forbearance and generosity.
tr.enSingable: The Family and Companions and all the Followers, ٭ The people of purity and patience and piety.
tr.id: Begitu pula segenap keluarga dan sahabat, serta tabi'in. Mereka ٭ adalah orang yang bertaqwa, bersih, santun, dan mulia.

lines.ar: يِا رَبِّ بِالمُصْطَفَى بَلِّغْ مَقَاصِدَنَا ٭ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا مَا مَضَى يَا وَاسِعَ الكَرَمِ
lines.translit: Yā rabbi bil muṣṭafā balligh maqāṣidanā ٭ Waghfir lanā mā maḍā yā wāsiʿal karami

tr.en: O Lord, by the Chosen One, allow us to attain our hopes ٭ And forgive us for what has gone past, O Vastly Generous.
tr.enSingable: My Lord, by the Chosen One, make our hopes come to be, ٭ And pardon us what has gone, O Vast in Gen'rosity.
tr.id: Ya Allah Dzat Yang Maha Dermawan, dengan tawassul lantaran kekasih-Mu Sang Nabi Pilihan ﷺ, kabulkanlah segala tujuan kami ٭ dan ampunilah dosa-dosa kami yang lampau.

lines.ar: وَاغْفِرْ إِلَهِي لِكُلِ المُسْلِمِينَ بِمَا ٭ يَتْلُونَ فِي المَسْجِدِ الأَقْصَى وَفِي الحَرَمِ
lines.translit: Waghfir ilāhī li kullil muslimīna bimā ٭ Yatluna fīl masjidil aqṣā wa fīl ḥarami

tr.en: And forgive, O God, all of the Muslims, by virtue ٭ Of what they recite in the Furthest Mosque [al-Aqṣā] and the Sacrosanct Mosque [al-Ḥaram]
tr.enSingable: And please, my God, do forgive all of the Muslims by what ٭ They all recite at the Holy Mosque and the Sanctity.
tr.id: Ya Allah, ampunilah dosa segenap muslimin dengan berkah ٭ apa yang mereka lantunkan di Masjidil Aqsha dan Masjidil Haram.

lines.ar: بِجَاهِ مَنْ بَيْتُهُ فِي طَيْبَةٍ حَرَمٌ ٭ وَاسْمُهُ قَسَمٌ مِنْ أَعْظَمِ الْقَسَمِ
lines.translit: Bijāhi man baytuhu fī ṭaybatin ḥaramun ٭ Wasmuhu qasamun min aʿẓamil qasami

tr.en: By the rank of him whose house is a sanctum in Ṭayba [Medina] ٭ And whose name is an oath—from the greatest of oaths!
tr.enSingable: By the prestige of him who the Goodly Land is his home; ٭ Whose very name is an oath of greatest immensity.
tr.id: Dengan lantaran derajat seorang rasul yang rumahnya berada di tanah mulia, Madinah al-Munawwarah, ٭ dan namanya menjadi salah satu sumpah yang paling agung.

lines.ar: وَهَذِهِ بُرْدَةُ المُخْتَارِ قَدْ خُتِمَتْ ٭ وَالحَمْدُ للهِ فِي بَدْءٍ وَفِي خَتَمِ
lines.translit: Wa hādhihi burdatul mukhtāri qad khutimat ٭ Walḥamdu liLlāhi fī badʾin wa fī khatami

tr.en: This Burda Ode of the Chosen One is thus complete ٭ And all praise is due to Allah in its beginning and its end.
tr.enSingable: This is the Burdah of the Selected One, now complete; ٭ And praise Allah at the start and finish, eternally!
tr.id: Inilah Qashidah al-Burdah yang telah rampung penulisannya. ٭ Segala puji bagi Allah pada permulaan hingga penutupan.

lines.ar: أَبْيَاتُهَا قَدْ أَتَتْ سِتِّينَ مَعْ مِائَةٍ ٭ فَرِّجْ بِهَا كَرْبَنَا يَا وَاسِعَ الْكَرَمِ
lines.translit: Abyātuhā qad atat sittīna maʿ miʾatin ٭ Farrij bihā karbanā yā wāsiʿal karami

tr.en: Its couplets—numbering one hundred and sixty—have come; ٭ Relieve us our difficulties by them, O Vastly Generous!
tr.enSingable: The number of verses in it is one sixty or more; ٭ Relieve by them our woes, O Vast in Gen'rosity!
tr.id: Untaian syairnya tersusun dari 160 bait. ٭ Wahai Dzat Yang Maha Pemurah, lapangkanlah kesusahan kami.
